15.4.s: ṛṇād ṛṇam iva saṃ naya kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛto gṛham | cakṣurmantrasya durhārdaḥ pṛṣṭīr api śṛṇāñjana ||
15.4.d: ऋणाद् ऋणम् इव सं नय कृत्यां कृत्याकृतो गृहम् । चक्षुर्मन्त्रस्य दुर्हार्दः पृष्टीर् अपि शृणाञ्जन ॥
15.4.m:
Lead back the witchcraft to the sorcerer's house, / like [paying] debt from debt!
Crush also the ribs / of the ill-hearted wielder of evil spells, O ointment!

15.4.s: yad asmāsu duṣvapnyaṃ yad goṣu yac ca no gṛhe | amāmagatyasta durhārdaḥ priya prati muñcatām ||
15.4.d: यद् अस्मासु दुष्वप्न्यं यद् गोषु यच् च नो गृहे । अमामगत्यस्त दुर्हार्दः प्रिय प्रति मुञ्चताम् ॥
15.4.m:
Whatever bad dream is among us, / whatever in the cattle and in our house,
let the hostile, ill-hearted enemy / fasten it upon his own dear ones!

15.4.s: apām ūrja ojaso vāvṛdhānam agner jātam adhi jātavedasaḥ | caturvīraṃ parvatīyaṃ yad āñjanaṃ diśaḥ pradiśaḥ karad ic chivās te ||
15.4.d: अपाम् ऊर्ज ओजसो वावृधानम् अग्नेर् जातम् अधि जातवेदसः । चतुर्वीरं पर्वतीयं यद् आञ्जनं दिशः प्रदिशः करद् इच् छिवास् ते ॥
15.4.m:
Thriving on the sap and might of the waters, / born from Agni Jātavedas—
whatever four-hero ointment is from the mountain, / let it make the directions and intermediate directions propitious for you!

15.4.s: caturvīraṃ badhyata āñjanaṃ te sarvā diśo abhayās te bhavantu | dhruvas tiṣṭhādhi saviteva vārya imā viśo abhi harantu te balim ||
15.4.d: चतुर्वीरं बध्यत आञ्जनं ते सर्वा दिशो अभयास् ते भवन्तु । ध्रुवस् तिष्ठाधि सवितेव वार्य इमा विशो अभि हरन्तु ते बलिम् ॥
15.4.m:
The four-hero ointment is bound on you; / let all directions be free of danger for you!
Stand firm like Savitṛ the protector; / let these clans bring tribute to you!

15.4.s: āṅkṣvaikaṃ maṇim ekaṃ kṛṇuṣva snāhy ekena pibaikam eṣām | caturvīraṃ nairṛtebhyaś caturbhyo grāhyā bandhebhyaḥ pari pātv asmān ||
15.4.d: आङ्क्ष्वैकं मणिम् एकं कृणुष्व स्नाह्य् एकेन पिबैकम् एषाम् । चतुर्वीरं नैरृतेभ्यश् चतुर्भ्यो ग्राह्या बन्धेभ्यः परि पात्व् अस्मान् ॥
15.4.m:
Anoint yourself with one, make one an amulet, / bathe with one, drink one of these!
Let the four-hero [ointment] protect us / from the four bonds of Nirṛti, [from the grasp] of Grāhī!

15.4.s: agnir māghnyenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
15.4.d: अग्निर् माघ्न्येनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे । वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
15.4.m:
May Agni protect me with the inviolable, / for in-breath, out-breath, [and] long life;
for splendor, force, and fiery energy; / for well-being and prosperity, svāhā!

15.4.s: indro mendryeṇāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
15.4.d: इन्द्रो मेन्द्र्येणावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे । वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
15.4.m:
May Indra protect me with his Indra-power, / for in-breath, out-breath, [and] long life;
for splendor, force, and fiery energy; / for well-being and prosperity, svāhā!

15.4.s: somo mā somyenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
15.4.d: सोमो मा सोम्येनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे । वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
15.4.m:
May Soma protect me with his Soma-nature, / for in-breath, out-breath, [and] long life;
for splendor, force, and fiery energy; / for well-being and prosperity, svāhā!

15.4.s: bhago mā bhagenāvatu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
15.4.d: भगो मा भगेनावतु प्राणायापानायायुषे । वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
15.4.m:
May Bhaga protect me with good fortune, / for in-breath, out-breath, [and] long life;
for splendor, force, and fiery energy; / for well-being and prosperity, svāhā!

15.4.s: maruto mā gaṇair avantu prāṇāyāpānāyāyuṣe | varcasa ojase tejase svastaye subhūtaye svāhā ||
15.4.d: मरुतो मा गणैर् अवन्तु प्राणायापानायायुषे । वर्चस ओजसे तेजसे स्वस्तये सुभूतये स्वाहा ॥
15.4.m:
May the Maruts protect me with their hosts, / for in-breath, out-breath, [and] long life;
for splendor, force, and fiery energy; / for well-being and prosperity, svāhā!

15.5.s: āyurdā deva jarasaṃ pṛṇāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtapṛṣṭho agne | ghṛtaṃ pibann amṛtaṃ cāru gavyaṃ piteva putraṃ jarase nayemam ||
15.5.d: आयुर्दा देव जरसं पृणानो घृतप्रतीको घृतपृष्ठो अग्ने । घृतं पिबन्न् अमृतं चारु गव्यं पितेव पुत्रं जरसे नयेमम् ॥
15.5.m:
O god who gives long life, fulfilling old age, / ghee-faced, ghee-backed, O Agni!
Drinking ghee, the lovely nectar of the cow, / lead this man to old age like a father his son!

15.5.s: āyur asmai dhehi jātavedaḥ prajāṃ tvaṣṭar adhi ni dhehy onaḥ | rāyaspoṣaṃ savitar ā suvāsmai śataṃ jīvāti śaradas tavāyam ||
15.5.d: आयुर् अस्मै धेहि जातवेदः प्रजां त्वष्टर् अधि नि धेह्य् ओनः । रायस्पोषं सवितर् आ सुवास्मै शतं जीवाति शरदस् तवायम् ॥
15.5.m:
Bestow long life upon him, O Jātavedas; / O Tvaṣṭṛ, place vigor down into his offspring!
Impel wealth and nourishment for him, O Savitṛ; / may this man of yours live a hundred autumns!

15.5.s: imam agna āyuṣe varcase dhāḥ priyaṃ reto varuṇa mitra rājan | mātevāsmā adite śarma yaccha viśve devā jaradaṣṭir jathāsat ||
15.5.d: इमम् अग्न आयुषे वर्चसे धाः प्रियं रेतो वरुण मित्र राजन् । मातेवास्मा अदिते शर्म यच्छ विश्वे देवा जरदष्टिर् जथासत् ॥
15.5.m:
Place this dear seed, O Agni, / for long life and splendor, O King Varuṇa, O Mitra!
Grant protection to him like a mother, O Aditi; / O All-gods, so that he may reach old age!

15.5.s: agniṣ ṭa āyuḥ prataraṃ kṛṇotu somas te puṣṭiṃ prataraṃ dadhātu | indro marutvān adhi te bravītv ādityais te aditiḥ śarma yacchatu ||
15.5.d: अग्निष् ट आयुः प्रतरं कृणोतु सोमस् ते पुष्टिं प्रतरं दधातु । इन्द्रो मरुत्वान् अधि ते ब्रवीत्व् आदित्यैस् ते अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ॥
15.5.m:
May Agni make your lifespan longer; / may Soma grant you further nourishment!
May Indra with the Maruts speak favorably of you; / may Aditi with the Ādityas grant you protection!

15.5.s: revatīs tvā vyakṣaṇaṃ kṛttikāś cakṛtus tvā | apasas tvām atanvata dhiyo 'vayann avāgnāyīr apṛñcan ||
15.5.d: रेवतीस् त्वा व्यक्षणं कृत्तिकाश् चकृतुस् त्वा । अपसस् त्वाम् अतन्वत धियो ऽवयन्न् अवाग्नायीर् अपृञ्चन् ॥
15.5.m:
The wealthy [nights] have prepared you, / the Kṛttikās have fashioned you;
the skilful [women] stretched you out, / the thoughts wove [you], the divine wives intertwined [you].

15.5.s: sahasram antām̐ abhito 'dadantā aśītir madhyam abhayaṃ vi nārīḥ | devīr devāya paridhe savitre mahat tad āsāmaghavan mahitvam ||
15.5.d: सहस्रम् अन्ताँ अभितो ऽददन्ता अशीतिर् मध्यम् अभयं वि नारीः । देवीर् देवाय परिधे सवित्रे महत् तद् आसामघवन् महित्वम् ॥
15.5.m:
A thousand women fastened the borders round about; / eighty women [fashioned] the secure center.
The divine [women wove] the garment for the divine Savitṛ; / great indeed was their greatness, O bounteous one!

15.5.s: imam aśmānam ā tiṣṭha aśmeva tvaṃ sthiro bhava | pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ sahasva pṛtaṇāyataḥ ||
15.5.d: इमम् अश्मानम् आ तिष्ठ अश्मेव त्वं स्थिरो भव । प्र मृणीहि दुरस्यतः सहस्व पृतणायतः ॥
15.5.m:
Step upon this stone; / be you firm like a stone!
Crush those who harbor ill will; / overcome those who contend in battle!

15.5.s: yena devaṃ savitāraṃ pari devā adhārayan | tenemaṃ brahmaṇaspate pari rāṣṭrāya dhattana ||
15.5.d: येन देवं सवितारं परि देवा अधारयन् । तेनेमं ब्रह्मणस्पते परि राष्ट्राय धत्तन ॥
15.5.m:
With which the gods clothed / god Savitṛ around,
with that, O Brahmaṇaspati, / clothe this man for royalty!

15.5.s: parīmam indram āyuṣe mahe kṣatrāya dhattana | yathainaṃ jarase nayāñ jyok kṣatre adhi jāgarat ||
15.5.d: परीमम् इन्द्रम् आयुषे महे क्षत्राय धत्तन । यथैनं जरसे नयाञ् ज्योक् क्षत्रे अधि जागरत् ॥
15.5.m:
Clothe this Indra for long life, / for great dominion,
so that they may lead him to old age / [and] he may remain watchful over dominion!

15.5.s: parīmaṃ somam āyuṣe mahe śrotrāya dhattana | yathainaṃ jarase nayāṃ jyok śrotre adhi jāgarat ||
15.5.d: परीमं सोमम् आयुषे महे श्रोत्राय धत्तन । यथैनं जरसे नयां ज्योक् श्रोत्रे अधि जागरत् ॥
15.5.m:
Clothe this Soma for long life, / for great hearing,
so that they may lead him to old age / [and] he may long remain watchful over hearing!

15.6.s: pari dhatta dhatta varcasemaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇuta dīrgham āyuḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ prāyacchad vāsa etat somāya rājñe paridhātavā u ||
15.6.d: परि धत्त धत्त वर्चसेमं जरामृत्युं कृणुत दीर्घम् आयुः । बृहस्पतिः प्रायच्छद् वास एतत् सोमाय राज्ञे परिधातवा उ ॥
15.6.m:
Clothe, clothe this man with splendor; / make him one who dies only of old age, [with] a long life!
Bṛhaspati presented this garment / to King Soma to put on.

15.6.s: jarāṃ su gaccha pari dhatsva vāso bhavā gṛṣṭīnām abhiśastivā u | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ suvarcā rāyaspoṣam upa saṃ vyayasva ||
15.6.d: जरां सु गच्छ परि धत्स्व वासो भवा गृष्टीनाम् अभिशस्तिवा उ । शतं च जीव शरदः सुवर्चा रायस्पोषम् उप सं व्ययस्व ॥
15.6.m:
Attain well to old age, put on the garment; / be an averter of the curse against the young cows!
Live a hundred autumns, full of splendor; / wrap yourself in abundance of wealth!

15.6.s: parīdaṃ vāso api dhāḥ svastaye 'bhūr vāpīnām abhiśastipā u | śataṃ ca jīva śaradaḥ purūcīr vasūni cārur vibhajāsi jīvan ||
15.6.d: परीदं वासो अपि धाः स्वस्तये ऽभूर् वापीनाम् अभिशस्तिपा उ । शतं च जीव शरदः पुरूचीर् वसूनि चारुर् विभजासि जीवन् ॥
15.6.m:
Put on this garment for well-being; / you have become a protector against the curse of the generous ones!
Live a hundred full autumns, / and, alive and charming, distribute riches!

15.6.s: yoge yoge tapastaraṃ vāje vāje havāmahe | sakhāya indram ūtaye ||
15.6.d: योगे योगे तपस्तरं वाजे वाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रम् ऊतये ॥
15.6.m: At every yoking, at every prize, / we, his companions, / call upon Indra for aid, [Indra] the most ardent.

15.6.s: hiraṇyavarṇo ajaraḥ suvīro jarāmṛtyuḥ prajayā saṃ viśasva | tad agnir āha tad u soma āha bṛhaspatiḥ savitā tad indraḥ ||
15.6.d: हिरण्यवर्णो अजरः सुवीरो जरामृत्युः प्रजया सं विशस्व । तद् अग्निर् आह तद् उ सोम आह बृहस्पतिः सविता तद् इन्द्रः ॥
15.6.m:
Golden-hued, unaging, rich in heroes, / dying of old age, enter [wealth] together with your offspring!
So speaks Agni, so speaks Soma, / so Bṛhaspati, Savitṛ, [and] Indra.

15.6.s: yadottamat tantu badhāya nāvadvāsaḥ pūrvayāvat pururūpapeśaḥ | bhadrātīkā samajaraṃ suvīraṃ tena devāḥ pra tirantv āyuḥ ||
15.6.d: यदोत्तमत् तन्तु बधाय नावद्वासः पूर्वयावत् पुरुरूपपेशः । भद्रातीका समजरं सुवीरं तेन देवाः प्र तिरन्त्व् आयुः ॥
15.6.m: When the thread has been tied on to bind, / a new garment, ancient, adorned with many forms, / auspicious-faced, unaging, rich in heroes— / with it let the gods prolong life!

15.6.s: yasya brāhmaṇaḥ sicam ārabhante śrathnanto nīvaṃ pratiranta āyuḥ | tasya devā devahūtiṃ juṣantāṃ sa viśvahā sacatāṃ svasti ||
15.6.d: यस्य ब्राह्मणः सिचम् आरभन्ते श्रथ्नन्तो नीवं प्रतिरन्त आयुः । तस्य देवा देवहूतिं जुषन्तां स विश्वहा सचतां स्वस्ति ॥
15.6.m:
The hem of whose [garment] the brāhmaṇas touch, / loosening the border, prolonging life—
may the gods enjoy his invocation of the gods; / may well-being accompany him at all times!

15.6.s: anyad ā dhatsva pari dhatsva vāsa imam ulbam apa lumpāmi yas te | jarase tvām ṛṣayaḥ saṃ vyayantu sūryo bhagas te pra tirantv āyuḥ ||
15.6.d: अन्यद् आ धत्स्व परि धत्स्व वास इमम् उल्बम् अप लुम्पामि यस् ते । जरसे त्वाम् ऋषयः सं व्ययन्तु सूर्यो भगस् ते प्र तिरन्त्व् आयुः ॥
15.6.m:
Put on another garment, wrap yourself in it; / I strip away this afterbirth of yours.
May the sages clothe you for old age; / may Sūrya and Bhaga prolong your life!

15.6.s: yasya devāsaḥ prathamavāsyaṃ harāmi taṃ tvā viśve avantu devāḥ | taṃ tvā bhrātaraḥ suvṛdhā vardhamānam anu jāyantāṃ bahavaḥ sujātam ||
15.6.d: यस्य देवासः प्रथमवास्यं हरामि तं त्वा विश्वे अवन्तु देवाः । तं त्वा भ्रातरः सुवृधा वर्धमानम् अनु जायन्तां बहवः सुजातम् ॥
15.6.m:
Whose first garment the gods take— / may all the gods protect you as such!
May many well-born brothers / be born following you who grow with vigorous growth!

15.6.s: ahatenāhato bhava sthira sthireṇa saṃ bhava | pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ ||
15.6.d: अहतेनाहतो भव स्थिर स्थिरेण सं भव । प्र मृणीहि दुरस्यतः सहस्व पृतनायतः ॥
15.6.m:
Be unhurt by what is unhurt; / be firm with what is firm!
Crush those who harbor ill will; / overcome those who contend in battle!

15.7.s: mitraḥ pṛthivyā adhyakṣaḥ | sa māvatv asmin brahmaṇy asmin karmaṇy asyāṃ purodhāyām asyāṃ dehahūtyām asyām ākūtyām asyām āśiṣi svāhā ||
15.7.d: मित्रः पृथिव्या अध्यक्षः । स मावत्व् अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्य् अस्मिन् कर्मण्य् अस्यां पुरोधायाम् अस्यां देहहूत्याम् अस्याम् आकूत्याम् अस्याम् आशिषि स्वाहा ॥
15.7.m: Mitra is the overseer of the earth. / May he protect me in this sacred prayer, in this rite, / in this priestly office, in this invocation of the body, / in this intention, in this blessing, svāhā!
Vāyu is the overseer of the intermediate space. / […]
The moon is the overseer of the constellations. / […]
Vasu is the overseer of the years. / […]
The year is the overseer of the seasons. / […]
Agni is the overseer of trees. / […]
Indra is the overseer of actions. / […]
Savitṛ is the overseer of impulses. / […]

15.8.m: Viṣṇu is the overseer of mountains. / […]
Tvaṣṭṛ is the overseer of forms. / […]
Rudra is the overseer of cattle. / […]
Soma is the overseer of milk-fluids. / […]
Parjanya is the overseer of plants. / […]
The ocean is the overseer of rivers. / […]
The hiṃkāra-sound is the overseer of sāmans. / May he [protect] me […]
Sarasvatī is the overseer of speeches. / May she [protect] me […]
Pūṣan is the overseer of paths. / May he [protect] me […]
Gāyatrī is the overseer of metres. / May she [protect] me […]

15.9.m: Bṛhaspati is the overseer of the gods. / […]
Prajāpati is the overseer of creatures. / […]

15.9.s: yamaḥ pitṝṇām adhyakṣaḥ | sa māvatv asmin … ||
15.9.d: यमः पितॄणाम् अध्यक्षः । स मावत्व् अस्मिन् … ॥
15.9.m: Yama is the overseer of the fathers. / May he protect me in this […]

15.9.s: pitaraḥ pare 'varas tatas tatāmahaḥ | te māvantv asmin brahmaṇy asmin karmaṇy asyāṃ purodhāyām asyāṃ devahūtyām asyām akūtyām asyām āśiṣi svāhā ||
15.9.d: पितरः परे ऽवरस् ततस् ततामहः । ते मावन्त्व् अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्य् अस्मिन् कर्मण्य् अस्यां पुरोधायाम् अस्यां देवहूत्याम् अस्याम् अकूत्याम् अस्याम् आशिषि स्वाहा ॥
15.9.m: Fathers who are distant, near, father and grandfather— / may they protect me in this sacred word, in this rite, / in this priestly office, in this invocation of the gods, in this / intention, in this blessing! Svāhā!

15.9.s: devānāṃ devā devā deveṣv adhidevāḥ parā kramadhvam | prathamā dvitīyeṣu dvitīyās tṛtīyeṣu ||
15.9.d: देवानां देवा देवा देवेष्व् अधिदेवाः परा क्रमध्वम् । प्रथमा द्वितीयेषु द्वितीयास् तृतीयेषु ॥
15.9.m: O gods of the gods, gods among the gods, sovereign gods, stride forward, / the first among the second, the second among the third!

15.9.s: trir ekādaśā viśve vaiśvānarā mahi mahānto na mārabhadhvam | idaṃ śakeyaṃ yad idaṃ kṛṇomi svāhā ||
15.9.d: त्रिर् एकादशा विश्वे वैश्वानरा महि महान्तो न मारभध्वम् । इदं शकेयं यद् इदं कृणोमि स्वाहा ॥
15.9.m: Three times eleven, all-gods belonging to all men, / great ones, do not take hold of me! / May I accomplish this which I perform! Svāhā!

15.10.s: jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yad varmī yāti samadām upasthe | anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu ||
15.10.d: जीमूतस्येव भवति प्रतीकं यद् वर्मी याति समदाम् उपस्थे । अनाविद्धया तन्वा जय त्वं स त्वा वर्मणो महिमा पिपर्तु ॥
15.10.m: Like the face of a raincloud it becomes / when the armored man goes into the lap of battles. / With an unwounded body do you conquer! / May the greatness of the armor rescue you!

15.10.s: dhanvanā gā dhanvanājiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema | dhanuḥ śatror apakāmaṃ kṛṇotu dhanvanā sarvāḥ pṛtanā jayema ||
15.10.d: धन्वना गा धन्वनाजिं जयेम धन्वना तीव्राः समदो जयेम । धनुः शत्रोर् अपकामं कृणोतु धन्वना सर्वाः पृतना जयेम ॥
15.10.m: With the bow may we win cattle, with the bow the contest; / with the bow may we win fierce battles. / May the bow frustrate the desire of the enemy; / with the bow may we conquer all armies.

15.10.s: vakṣyantīved ā ganīganti karṇaṃ priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā | yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañ jyā iyaṃ samiti pārayantī ||
15.10.d: वक्ष्यन्तीवेद् आ गनीगन्ति कर्णं प्रियं सखायं परिषस्वजाना । योषेव शिङ्क्ते वितताधि धन्वञ् ज्या इयं समिति पारयन्ती ॥
15.10.m: As if about to speak it approaches close to the ear, / embracing its dear companion; / singing like a woman, stretched across the bow, / this bowstring carrying through in the encounter.

15.10.s: te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ pipṛtām upasthe | apa śatrūn vidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime visphurantī amitrān ||
15.10.d: ते आचरन्ती समनेव योषा मातेव पुत्रं पिपृताम् उपस्थे । अप शत्रून् विध्यतां संविदाने आर्त्नी इमे विस्फुरन्ती अमित्रान् ॥
15.10.m: These two, acting together like women at an assembly, / like a mother a son, let them protect [him] in their lap. / In harmony let them pierce away the foes, / these two bow-tips, hurling back the enemies.

15.10.s: bahvīnāṃ pitā bahur asya putro vyacaḥ kṛṇoti samado 'vagatya | iṣudhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛtanāś ca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ ||
15.10.d: बह्वीनां पिता बहुर् अस्य पुत्रो व्यचः कृणोति समदो ऽवगत्य । इषुधिः सङ्काः पृतनाश् च सर्वाः पृष्ठे निनद्धो जयति प्रसूतः ॥
15.10.m: Father of many [arrows], his son is abundant; / he makes wide space, descending into the battles. / The quiver, overcoming clashes and all armies, / fastened on the back, wins when brought forth.

15.10.s: rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ | abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥ paścād anu yacchanti raśmayaḥ ||
15.10.d: रथे तिष्ठन् नयति वाजिनः पुरो यत्रयत्र कामयते सुषारथिः । अभीशूनां महिमानं पनायत मनः पश्चाद् अनु यच्छन्ति रश्मयः ॥
15.10.m: Standing on the chariot, the good charioteer / leads the prize-winning steeds forward wherever he desires. / Marvel at the greatness of the reins: / from behind, the traces direct the mind [of the horses].

15.10.s: tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvatāṃ vṛṣapāṇayo 'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ | apakrāmantaḥ prapadair amitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūṃr anapavyayantaḥ ||
15.10.d: तीव्रान् घोषान् कृण्वतां वृषपाणयो ऽश्वा रथेभिः सह वाजयन्तः । अपक्रामन्तः प्रपदैर् अमित्रान् क्षिणन्ति शत्रूंर् अनपव्ययन्तः ॥
15.10.m: Making fierce shouts, the strong-hoofed horses / speed along with the chariots, / trampling down the foes with their forefeet, / they destroy the enemies, never turning away.

15.10.s: rathavāhanaṃ havir asya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitam asya varma | tatrā ratham upa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ ||
15.10.d: रथवाहनं हविर् अस्य नाम यत्रायुधं निहितम् अस्य वर्म । तत्रा रथम् उप शग्मं सदेम विश्वाहा वयं सुमनस्यमानाः ॥
15.10.m: The chariot-stand is named his oblation, / where his weapon is laid, his armor. / There let us sit by the helpful chariot / on all days, being of good mind.

15.10.s: svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ | citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ ||
15.10.d: स्वादुषंसदः पितरो वयोधाः कृच्छ्रेश्रितः शक्तीवन्तो गभीराः । चित्रसेना इषुबला अमृध्राः सतोवीरा उरवो व्रातसाहाः ॥
15.10.m: The fathers, seated in sweet fellowship, giving vigor, / having recourse to difficult straits, mighty, deep, / with brilliant armies, having the strength of arrows, unyielding, / possessing real heroes, broad, overcoming troops.

15.10.s: brahmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā | pūṣā naḥ pātu dūritād ṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākir ṇo aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
15.10.d: ब्रह्मणासः पितरः सोम्यासः शिवे नो द्यावापृथिवी अनेहसा । पूषा नः पातु दूरिताद् ऋतावृधो रक्षा माकिर् णो अघशंस ईशत ॥
15.10.m: Priestly fathers, worthy of soma, / auspicious for us, guiltless Heaven and Earth! / May Pūṣan protect us from misfortune, increaser of truth! / Protect [us]! May no maligner master us!

15.11.s: bṛhaspatir naḥ pari pātu paścād utottarasmād adharād aghāyoḥ | indraḥ purastād uta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu ||
15.11.d: बृहस्पतिर् नः परि पातु पश्चाद् उतोत्तरस्माद् अधराद् अघायोः । इन्द्रः पुरस्ताद् उत मध्यतो नः सखा सखिभ्यो वरिवः कृणोतु ॥
15.11.m: May Bṛhaspati protect us from behind, / and from above, from below, against the malicious. / May Indra from the front and from the middle, / a comrade for comrades, make wide room for us.

15.11.s: suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ saṃnaddhā patati prasūtā | yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tad asmabhyam iṣavaḥ śarma yacchān ||
15.11.d: सुपर्णं वस्ते मृगो अस्या दन्तो गोभिः संनद्धा पतति प्रसूता । यत्रा नरः सं च वि च द्रवन्ति तद् अस्मभ्यम् इषवः शर्म यच्छान् ॥
15.11.m: She wears fair feathers; the beast [horn] is her tooth; / bound with cow-hide, she flies forth when discharged. / Where men run together and scatter apart, / there may the arrows grant us shelter.

15.11.s: suparṇo vāso yad u sarpir āsā mano hiraṇyam iṣavaḥ patatrī | māsmāṅ arann amuta āpatantīr itaḥ prahitāḥ savitar jayantu ||
15.11.d: सुपर्णो वासो यद् उ सर्पिर् आसा मनो हिरण्यम् इषवः पतत्री । मास्माङ् अरन्न् अमुत आपतन्तीर् इतः प्रहिताः सवितर् जयन्तु ॥
15.11.m: Fair-feathered is the garment, and butter is the mouth; / of mind, of gold are the winged arrows. / May they flying from yonder not strike us; / shot from here, O Savitṛ, let them conquer!

15.11.s: ahir iva bhogaiḥ pary eti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetim apabādhamānaḥ | hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāṃsaṃ pari pātu mṛtyoḥ ||
15.11.d: अहिर् इव भोगैः पर्य् एति बाहुं ज्याया हेतिम् अपबाधमानः । हस्तघ्नो विश्वा वयुनानि विद्वान् पुमान् पुमांसं परि पातु मृत्योः ॥
15.11.m: Like a snake with coils it encircles the arm, / warding off the blow of the bowstring. / The hand-guard, knowing all skills, / a man, let it protect the man from death.

15.11.s: ā jaṅghanti sānv eṣāṃ jaghanām̐ upa jighnate | aśvājani tra pracodaya aśvān samatsu pādaya ||
15.11.d: आ जङ्घन्ति सान्व् एषां जघनाँ उप जिघ्नते । अश्वाजनि त्र प्रचोदय अश्वान् समत्सु पादय ॥
15.11.m: They strike their flanks; / they beat upon their buttocks. / O horse-whip, urge on— / make the horses charge in the battles!

15.11.s: divas pṛthivyāḥ pary oja ābhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ pari saṃbhṛtaṃ sahaḥ | apām ojmānaṃ pari gobhir ābhṛtam indrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||
15.11.d: दिवस् पृथिव्याः पर्य् ओज आभृतं वनस्पतिभ्यः परि संभृतं सहः । अपाम् ओज्मानं परि गोभिर् आभृतम् इन्द्रस्य वज्रं हविषा रथं यज ॥
15.11.m: Power brought from heaven, from earth; / might gathered from the trees; / the vigor of the waters brought around with cow-hides: / worship with an oblation the chariot, Indra's thunderbolt!

15.11.s: indrasya vajro marutām anīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ | semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
15.11.d: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो मरुताम् अनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः । सेमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
15.11.m: Indra's thunderbolt, the face of the Maruts, / Mitra's embryo, Varuṇa's navel— / enjoying this our offering of oblations, / divine chariot, receive the oblations!

15.11.s: vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ | gobhiḥ saṃnaddho ratha vīḍayasva āsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
15.11.d: वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गो हि भूया अस्मत्सखा प्रतरणः सुवीरः । गोभिः संनद्धो रथ वीडयस्व आस्थाता ते जयतु जेत्वानि ॥
15.11.m: O tree, be of firm limbs indeed, / our companion, advancing, of good warriors! / Bound with cow-hides, O chariot, be strong! / May he who mounts you win what is to be won!

15.11.s: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat | sa dundubhe sajūr indreṇa devair dūrād davīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
15.11.d: उप श्वासय पृथिवीम् उत द्यां पुरुत्रा ते मनुतां विष्ठितं जगत् । स दुन्दुभे सजूर् इन्द्रेण देवैर् दूराद् दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून् ॥
15.11.m: Sound through earth and heaven! / In many places let the moving world take heed of you! / In company with Indra, with the gods, O drum, / drive away the enemies further than far!

15.11.s: ā krandaya balam ojo na ā dhā abhi ṣṭana duritā bādhamānaḥ | apa sedha dundubhe ducchunām ita indrasya muṣṭir asi vīḍayasva ||
15.11.d: आ क्रन्दय बलम् ओजो न आ धा अभि ष्टन दुरिता बाधमानः । अप सेध दुन्दुभे दुच्छुनाम् इत इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिर् असि वीडयस्व ॥
15.11.m: Roar out; put strength in us! / Thunder, warding off misfortunes! / Drive away [the foes] from here, O drum! / You are Indra's fist: be strong!

15.12.s: prāmūñ jayābhīme jayantu ketumad dundubhir vāvadītu | sam aśvaparṇāḥ patayantu no naro 'smākam indra rathino jayantu ||
15.12.d: प्रामूञ् जयाभीमे जयन्तु केतुमद् दुन्दुभिर् वावदीतु । सम् अश्वपर्णाः पतयन्तु नो नरो ऽस्माकम् इन्द्र रथिनो जयन्तु ॥
15.12.m: Conquer those yonder; let these conquer! / Let the drum proclaim loudly, endowed with a banner! / Let our men fly together with winged horses; / O Indra, let our charioteers conquer!

15.12.s: indro rathāya prapadaṃ kṛṇotu yam adhyaṣṭhān maghavā jayantām | irya iva paśubhir yuyotu gopā ariṣṭo jātaḥ prathamaḥ siṣāsan ||
15.12.d: इन्द्रो रथाय प्रपदं कृणोतु यम् अध्यष्ठान् मघवा जयन्ताम् । इर्य इव पशुभिर् युयोतु गोपा अरिष्टो जातः प्रथमः सिषासन् ॥
15.12.m: May Indra make a forepart for the chariot, / which the bounteous ones mounted—let them conquer! / Like an active herdsman, let him ward off with cattle, / unhurt, born first.

15.12.s: parjanyasyeva stanayitnur āsor indrāgnyor iva cekhidyate ghoṣo asya | sāhasro vīraḥ śataṃ sasanvān ayutaṃ sasanvān ratha mṛḍeha ||
15.12.d: पर्जन्यस्येव स्तनयित्नुर् आसोर् इन्द्राग्न्योर् इव चेखिद्यते घोषो अस्य । साहस्रो वीरः शतं ससन्वान् अयुतं ससन्वान् रथ मृडेह ॥
15.12.m: Like the thunderer of Parjanya from its mouth, / like that of Indra and Agni, its roar resounds. / Hero of a thousand, winning a hundred, / winning ten thousand, O chariot, be gracious here!

15.12.s: śyenasya pakṣau hariṇasya bāhū indrasya muṣṭir marutām anīkam | gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīḍayasva ||
15.12.d: श्येनस्य पक्षौ हरिणस्य बाहू इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिर् मरुताम् अनीकम् । गोभिः संनद्धो असि वीडयस्व ॥
15.12.m: The two wings of the hawk, the two arms of the deer, / the fist of Indra, the troop of the Maruts— / you are bound with cow-hides: be strong!

15.12.s: ud yaṃyamīti sahiteva bāhū ubhe sicau yajate bhīma ṛñjan | uc chukram atkam ajate śacībhir navā mātṛbhyo vasanā jahāti ||
15.12.d: उद् यंयमीति सहितेव बाहू उभे सिचौ यजते भीम ऋञ्जन् । उच् छुक्रम् अत्कम् अजते शचीभिर् नवा मातृभ्यो वसना जहाति ॥
15.12.m: He stretches out both arms together, as it were; / the terrible one, speeding, sacrifices on both borders. / By his wondrous powers he drives up the bright cloak; / he leaves new garments to the mothers.

15.12.s: ugrau te nemī pavī ta ugrā ugrāḥ śaṅkavo bṛhato rathasya | īṣātra veṇavo namatis ta ugrā agniś cakṣuḥ pravayaṇaṃ rathasya | tenāmitrān pramṛṇan yāhi śatrūn ||
15.12.d: उग्रौ ते नेमी पवी त उग्रा उग्राः शङ्कवो बृहतो रथस्य । ईषात्र वेणवो नमतिस् त उग्रा अग्निश् चक्षुः प्रवयणं रथस्य । तेनामित्रान् प्रमृणन् याहि शत्रून् ॥
15.12.m: Fierce are your two fellies, fierce your two tires, / fierce are the pegs of the great chariot. / The pole, the reeds, your rim is fierce; / Agni is the eye, the driver of the chariot. / Crushing the unfriendlies, go against the enemies with it!

15.12.s: arā nābhayo balam it te akṣa ugrau te koṣau saha nisyadābhyām | āṇyor vadhrān uta koṣaghorā sthānaṃ bandha uta vandhuraṃ te ||
15.12.d: अरा नाभयो बलम् इत् ते अक्ष उग्रौ ते कोषौ सह निस्यदाभ्याम् । आण्योर् वध्रान् उत कोषघोरा स्थानं बन्ध उत वन्धुरं ते ॥
15.12.m: The spokes, the hubs, strength indeed is your axle; / fierce are your two boxes along with the discharges; / the leather straps of the linchpins and the terrible boxes, / your seat, your fastening, and your seat-frame!

15.12.s: goṣṭhe balaṃ mṛga ekam aṅgaṃ parā kramadhvaṃ maha ā suvanta | abhīśavo hatānena vṛtram ayaṃ kṣatreṇa prajayāstūgraḥ ||
15.12.d: गोष्ठे बलं मृग एकम् अङ्गं परा क्रमध्वं मह आ सुवन्त । अभीशवो हतानेन वृत्रम् अयं क्षत्रेण प्रजयास्तूग्रः ॥
15.12.m: In the stall is strength; the beast is one limb; / stride forth, impelling great [might]! / O reins, slay Vṛtra with this! / May this one be fierce through dominion and offspring!

15.12.s: ā tiṣṭha jiṣṇus tarasā sapatnān sāhasro vīraḥ pramṛṇan yāhi śatrūn | pṛṣṭiyuge kṛṇutaṃ vīryāṇi tad etām etaṃ ratham asya śagme ||
15.12.d: आ तिष्ठ जिष्णुस् तरसा सपत्नान् साहस्रो वीरः प्रमृणन् याहि शत्रून् । पृष्टियुगे कृणुतं वीर्याणि तद् एताम् एतं रथम् अस्य शग्मे ॥
15.12.m: Mount, victorious through speed over rivals; / a hero of a thousand, go forth crushing the enemies! / Perform heroic deeds at the side-yoke! / Therefore approach, approach this chariot of his, in strength!

15.12.s: aṣṭau cakṣūṃṣi kavayaḥ saṃ namantv aśvā prākāśā ṛju dhāvayantaḥ | anu tvā skambho dadatāṃ piteva cakramāṇam ainaṃ dhatsvopasthe pra tirāty āyuḥ ||
15.12.d: अष्टौ चक्षूंषि कवयः सं नमन्त्व् अश्वा प्राकाशा ऋजु धावयन्तः । अनु त्वा स्कम्भो ददतां पितेव चक्रमाणम् ऐनं धत्स्वोपस्थे प्र तिरात्य् आयुः ॥
15.12.m: Let the poets bend the eight eyes together, / making the horses run straight and bright! / May the support yield behind you as a father to [his son] stepping out; / place him in your lap, prolong his life!

15.12.s: kavibhiḥ syūtaḥ sa rathe vibaddhaḥ sa dhanvadhir dhanucitte jajāna | anuprāsyemāni pṛthumadhyamāny aśvebhyaḥ śaṃtvāya kavibhiḥ kṛtāni tebhiṣ ṭe śarma yacchantu devāḥ ||
15.12.d: कविभिः स्यूतः स रथे विबद्धः स धन्वधिर् धनुचित्ते जजान । अनुप्रास्येमानि पृथुमध्यमान्य् अश्वेभ्यः शंत्वाय कविभिः कृतानि तेभिष् टे शर्म यच्छन्तु देवाः ॥
15.12.m: Sewn by the poets, bound to the chariot, / that bow-case was born from the design of the bow. / Having thrown these wide-centered [accoutrements] / made by the poets for the welfare of the horses, / with them let the gods grant you protection!

15.13.s: agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn oṣadhīr uta vīrudhaḥ | indraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sūryaṃ te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.13.d: अग्निं ब्रूमो वनस्पतीन् ओषधीर् उत वीरुधः । इन्द्रं बृहस्पतिं सूर्यं ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.13.m: We address Agni, the trees of the forest, / the plants, and the creeping shrubs; / Indra, Bṛhaspati, Sūrya— / may they release us from distress!

15.13.s: brūmo devaṃ savitāraṃ dhātāram uta pūṣaṇam | tvaṣṭāram agryaṃ brūmas te … ||
15.13.d: ब्रूमो देवं सवितारं धातारम् उत पूषणम् । त्वष्टारम् अग्र्यं ब्रूमस् ते … ॥
15.13.m: We address the god Savitṛ, / Dhātṛ, and Pūṣan; / we address foremost Tvaṣṭṛ— / may they […]!

15.13.s: brūmo rājānaṃ varuṇaṃ mitraṃ viṣṇum atho bhagam | aṃśaṃ vivasvantaṃ brūmas te … ||
15.13.d: ब्रूमो राजानं वरुणं मित्रं विष्णुम् अथो भगम् । अंशं विवस्वन्तं ब्रूमस् ते … ॥
15.13.m: We address King Varuṇa, / Mitra, Viṣṇu, and Bhaga; / we address Aṃśa and Vivasvant— / may they […]!

15.13.s: gandharvāpsaraso brūmo aśvinā brahmaṇaspatim | aryamā nāma yo devas te … ||
15.13.d: गन्धर्वाप्सरसो ब्रूमो अश्विना ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् । अर्यमा नाम यो देवस् ते … ॥
15.13.m: We address the Gandharvas and Apsarases, / the two Aśvins, Brahmaṇaspati, / [and] the god who is named Aryaman— / may they […]!

15.13.s: vātaṃ brūmaḥ parjanyam antarikṣam atho diśaḥ | āśāś ca sarvā brūmas te … ||
15.13.d: वातं ब्रूमः पर्जन्यम् अन्तरिक्षम् अथो दिशः । आशाश् च सर्वा ब्रूमस् ते … ॥
15.13.m: We address the wind, Parjanya, / the intermediate space, and the quarters; / and we address all the regions— / may they […]!

15.13.s: ahorātre idaṃ brūma sūryācandramasā ubhā | ādityān sarvān brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.13.d: अहोरात्रे इदं ब्रूम सूर्याचन्द्रमसा उभा । आदित्यान् सर्वान् ब्रूमस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.13.m: Here we address day and night, / both Sun and Moon; / we address all the Ādityas— / may they release us from distress!

15.13.s: muñcantu mā śapathyād ahorātre atho uṣāḥ | somo mā divyo muñcatu yam āhuś candramā iti ||
15.13.d: मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्याद् अहोरात्रे अथो उषाः । सोमो मा दिव्यो मुञ्चतु यम् आहुश् चन्द्रमा इति ॥
15.13.m: May day and night release me from the curse, / and also the Dawns; / may the heavenly Soma release me, / whom they call the Moon!

15.13.s: pañca rājyāni vīrudhāṃ somaśreṣṭhāni brūmasi | bhaṅgo darbho yavaḥ sahas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.13.d: पञ्च राज्यानि वीरुधां सोमश्रेष्ठानि ब्रूमसि । भङ्गो दर्भो यवः सहस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.13.m: The five kingdoms of plants, / with Soma as the foremost, we address: / hemp, darbha-grass, barley, strength— / may they release us from distress!

15.13.s: ye grāmyāḥ sapta paśava āraṇyā uta ye mṛgāḥ | śakuntān pakṣiṇo brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.13.d: ये ग्राम्याः सप्त पशव आरण्या उत ये मृगाः । शकुन्तान् पक्षिणो ब्रूमस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.13.m: The seven domestic animals that there are, / and the wild beasts of the forest; / we address the birds, the winged ones— / may they release us from distress!

15.13.s: bhavāśarvāv idaṃ brūma ugraḥ paśupatiś ca yaḥ | iṣūr yā eṣāṃ vidmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.13.d: भवाशर्वाव् इदं ब्रूम उग्रः पशुपतिश् च यः । इषूर् या एषां विद्मस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.13.m: Here we address Bhava and Śarva, / and he who is fierce, Paśupati; / the arrows that are theirs, we know— / may they release us from distress!

15.14.s: yajñaṃ brūmo yajamānam ṛcaḥ sāmāni bheṣajā | yajūṃṣi hotrān brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.14.d: यज्ञं ब्रूमो यजमानम् ऋचः सामानि भेषजा । यजूंषि होत्रान् ब्रूमस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.14.m: We address the sacrifice, the sacrificer, / the verses, the chants, the remedies; / we address the sacrificial formulas, the priestly offices— / may they release us from distress!

15.14.s: ṛtūn brūma ṛtupatīn ārtavām̐ uta hāyanān | samāḥ saṃvatsarān māsas te no … ||
15.14.d: ऋतून् ब्रूम ऋतुपतीन् आर्तवाँ उत हायनान् । समाः संवत्सरान् मासस् ते नो … ॥
15.14.m: We address the seasons, the lords of seasons, / the seasonal periods, and the years; / the half-years, the years, the months— / may they […] us!

15.14.s: divaṃ brūmo nakṣatrāṇi bhūmiṃ yakṣāṇi parvatān | samudrā nadyo veśantās te … ||
15.14.d: दिवं ब्रूमो नक्षत्राणि भूमिं यक्षाणि पर्वतान् । समुद्रा नद्यो वेशन्तास् ते … ॥
15.14.m: We address the sky, the asterisms, / the earth, the spirits, the mountains; / the oceans, the rivers, the ponds— / may they […]!

15.14.s: sapta ṛṣīn vā idaṃ brūmo 'po devīḥ prajāpatim | pitṝn yamaśreṣṭhān brūmas te … ||
15.14.d: सप्त ऋषीन् वा इदं ब्रूमो ऽपो देवीः प्रजापतिम् । पितॄन् यमश्रेष्ठान् ब्रूमस् ते … ॥
15.14.m: Or here we address the seven seers, / the divine waters, Prajāpati; / we address the Fathers with Yama at their head— / may they […]!

15.14.s: viśvān devān idaṃ brūmaḥ satyasandhān ṛtāvṛdhaḥ | viśvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ sākaṃ te … ||
15.14.d: विश्वान् देवान् इदं ब्रूमः सत्यसन्धान् ऋतावृधः । विश्वाभिः पत्नीभिः साकं ते … ॥
15.14.m: Here we address all the gods, / true to their pacts, increasers of Ṛta; / together with all their wives— / may they […]!

15.14.s: ādityā rudrā vasavo devā daivā atharvaṇaḥ | aṅgiraso manīṣiṇas te … ||
15.14.d: आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो देवा दैवा अथर्वणः । अङ्गिरसो मनीषिणस् ते … ॥
15.14.m: The Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, / the divine gods, the Atharvans, / the wise Aṅgirases— / may they […]!

15.14.s: ye devā diviṣado 'ntarikṣasadaś ca ye | pṛthivyāṃ śakrā ye śritās te … ||
15.14.d: ये देवा दिविषदो ऽन्तरिक्षसदश् च ये । पृथिव्यां शक्रा ये श्रितास् ते … ॥
15.14.m: The gods who dwell in heaven, / and those who dwell in the intermediate space, / the mighty ones who are stationed on earth— / may they […]!

15.14.s: eta devā dakṣiṇataḥ paśvāt prāñca ud etana purastāc chakrā uttarād viśve devāḥ sametya te … ||
15.14.d: एत देवा दक्षिणतः पश्वात् प्राञ्च उद् एतन पुरस्ताच् छक्रा उत्तराद् विश्वे देवाः समेत्य ते … ॥
15.14.m: Come, O gods, from the south! / Rise up from the west facing east, / the mighty ones from the east, from the north! / All the gods, having assembled, / may they […]!

15.14.s: arāyān brūmo rakṣāṃsi sarpān puṇyajanān uta | mṛtyūn ekaśataṃ brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.14.d: अरायान् ब्रूमो रक्षांसि सर्पान् पुण्यजनान् उत । मृत्यून् एकशतं ब्रूमस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.14.m: We address the niggards, the rakṣases, / the serpents, and the Puṇyajanas; / we address the hundred and one deaths— / may they release us from distress!

15.14.s: yā devīḥ pañca pradiśo ye devā dvādaśartavaḥ | saṃvatsarasya ye daṃṣṭrās te naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ ||
15.14.d: या देवीः पञ्च प्रदिशो ये देवा द्वादशर्तवः । संवत्सरस्य ये दंष्ट्रास् ते नः सन्तु सदा शिवाः ॥
15.14.m: The divine five intermediate directions, / the gods who are the twelve seasons, / those who are the fangs of the year— / may they be ever propitious to us!

15.14.s: bhūtaṃ brūmo bhūtapatiṃ bhūtānām uta yas patiḥ | bhūtāni sarvā brūmas te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
15.14.d: भूतं ब्रूमो भूतपतिं भूतानाम् उत यस् पतिः । भूतानि सर्वा ब्रूमस् ते नो मुञ्चन्त्व् अंहसः ॥
15.14.m: We address the past, the lord of beings, / and he who is the lord of beings; / we address all beings— / may they release us from distress!

15.15.s: yāvad dyaur yāvat pṛthivī yāvat paryeti sūryaḥ | tāvat tvam ugra oṣadhe pari pāhy arundhati ||
15.15.d: यावद् द्यौर् यावत् पृथिवी यावत् पर्येति सूर्यः । तावत् त्वम् उग्र ओषधे परि पाह्य् अरुन्धति ॥
15.15.m: As far as heaven, as far as earth, / as far as the sun revolves around, / so far, O fierce plant, / protect [him] on all sides, O Arundhatī!

15.15.s: ariṣṭas tvā khanaty ariṣṭāya khanāmi tvā | dvipāc catuṣpād asmākaṃ sarvam astv anāturam ||
15.15.d: अरिष्टस् त्वा खनत्य् अरिष्टाय खनामि त्वा । द्विपाच् चतुष्पाद् अस्माकं सर्वम् अस्त्व् अनातुरम् ॥
15.15.m: Uninjured, [the digger] digs you; / for one uninjured I dig you. / May our two-footed and four-footed [kin], / may all be free of affliction!

15.15.s: devānām asi svasā marutām asi sañcarī | yaṃ jīvam aśnuṣe tvaṃ na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ ||
15.15.d: देवानाम् असि स्वसा मरुताम् असि सञ्चरी । यं जीवम् अश्नुषे त्वं न स रिष्याति पूरुषः ॥
15.15.m: You are the sister of the gods, / you are the companion of the Maruts. / Which living man you reach, / that man shall not be harmed.

15.15.s: arundhatī nāmāsi tṛtīyasyām ito divi | tatrāmṛtasya rohaṇaṃ tena tvācchāvadāmasi ||
15.15.d: अरुन्धती नामासि तृतीयस्याम् इतो दिवि । तत्रामृतस्य रोहणं तेन त्वाच्छावदामसि ॥
15.15.m: Arundhatī is your name / in the third heaven from here; / there is the growth of immortality: / thereby we summon you!

15.15.s: śaṃ ta āpo hṛdyāḥ śaṃ te kulijyā uta | śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ te tapatu sūryaḥ ||
15.15.d: शं त आपो हृद्याः शं ते कुलिज्या उत । शं वातः शं बृहस्पतिः शं ते तपतु सूर्यः ॥
15.15.m: Auspicious to you be the waters from the heart, / and auspicious to you those from the water-channels; / auspicious be the wind, auspicious Bṛhaspati; / may the sun shine auspiciously upon you!

15.15.s: śaṃ ta indrāgnī bhavatāṃ śaṃ rātrī prati dhīyatām | śaṃ te pṛthivyāṃ vīrudhaḥ śam u te santv oṣadhīḥ ||
15.15.d: शं त इन्द्राग्नी भवतां शं रात्री प्रति धीयताम् । शं ते पृथिव्यां वीरुधः शम् उ ते सन्त्व् ओषधीः ॥
15.15.m: May Indra and Agni be auspicious to you; / may the night be set auspiciously [for you]; / auspicious to you be the creeping shrubs on earth, / and auspicious may the plants be to you!

15.15.s: bahvīṣu hi tvām avidam oṣadhīṃ vīryavatīm | arundhati tvām āhārṣam ito mā pārayān iti ||
15.15.d: बह्वीषु हि त्वाम् अविदम् ओषधीं वीर्यवतीम् । अरुन्धति त्वाम् आहार्षम् इतो मा पारयान् इति ॥
15.15.m: For among many I have found you, / the potent plant. / O Arundhatī, I have fetched you, / saying: 'Carry me across from here!'

15.15.s: abhiprepseva jīvantam abhi dasyed arundhatī | eṣā daviddya bheṣajī devī vātīkṛtasya ca ||
15.15.d: अभिप्रेप्सेव जीवन्तम् अभि दस्येद् अरुन्धती । एषा दविद्द्य भेषजी देवी वातीकृतस्य च ॥
15.15.m: As if seeking to reach the living one, / Arundhatī should be exhausted for [him]; / this healing goddess removes [afflictions], / and also [heals] the one afflicted by wind.

15.15.s: anu ṣiñca nas tat kurv agado vai bhaviṣyati | vātīkṛtasya bheṣajy āgan devy arundhatī ||
15.15.d: अनु षिञ्च नस् तत् कुर्व् अगदो वै भविष्यति । वातीकृतस्य भेषज्य् आगन् देव्य् अरुन्धती ॥
15.15.m: Sprinkle after us, do that: / he will indeed be free from disease! / The healing goddess Arundhatī / has come for the one afflicted by wind.

15.15.s: mā bibher na mariṣyasy agado vai bhaviṣyasi | vātīkṛtasya bheṣajy āgan devy arundhatī ||
15.15.d: मा बिभेर् न मरिष्यस्य् अगदो वै भविष्यसि । वातीकृतस्य भेषज्य् आगन् देव्य् अरुन्धती ॥
15.15.m: Do not fear, you will not die; / you will indeed be free from disease! / The healing goddess Arundhatī / has come for the one afflicted by wind.

15.16.s: arundhatyaḥ saṃ vadante gāvaḥ pravrājinīr iva | yam āturam abhigaccha amāvataṃ kṛṇu māvatam ||
15.16.d: अरुन्धत्यः सं वदन्ते गावः प्रव्राजिनीर् इव । यम् आतुरम् अभिगच्छ अमावतं कृणु मावतम् ॥
15.16.m: The Arundhatī-plants converse together / like cows roaming forth: / 'Whichever afflicted person I approach, / make him akin to me, like me!'

15.16.s: imaṃ me tvaṃ jarāmṛtyuṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṇv oṣadhe | rājñī hi sarvāsām asy oṣadhīnām arundhatī ||
15.16.d: इमं मे त्वं जरामृत्युं पुरुषं कृण्व् ओषधे । राज्ञी हि सर्वासाम् अस्य् ओषधीनाम् अरुन्धती ॥
15.16.m: Make this man of mine reach old-age death, / O plant! / For you are the queen of all / plants, O Arundhatī!

15.16.s: trāyamāṇā hy asi jīvalā vīryāvatī | arundhati tvām āhārṣam ito mā pārayān iti ||
15.16.d: त्रायमाणा ह्य् असि जीवला वीर्यावती । अरुन्धति त्वाम् आहार्षम् इतो मा पारयान् इति ॥
15.16.m: For you are the protectress, / life-giving, full of potency. / O Arundhatī, I have fetched you, / saying: 'Carry me across from here!'

15.16.s: digdhena ca viddhasya aghasyāghaviṣā ca yā | arundhati tvaṃ tasyāsi viṣasya viṣadūṣaṇī ||
15.16.d: दिग्धेन च विद्धस्य अघस्याघविषा च या । अरुन्धति त्वं तस्यासि विषस्य विषदूषणी ॥
15.16.m: Both of the one pierced by a poisoned [arrow], / and of the baleful [wound] whose venom is baleful: / O Arundhatī, of that poison / you are the poison-spoiler.
And of the one bitten by a snake, / of the baleful […]
And of the one struck down by a windy ailment, / of the baleful […]

15.17.m: And struck down by the fierce god […] / […]

15.17.s: īśānena ca kṣiptasya aghasyāghaviṣā ca yā | arundhati … ||
15.17.d: ईशानेन च क्षिप्तस्य अघस्याघविषा च या । अरुन्धति … ॥
15.17.m: And struck down by Īśāna, / of the baleful [wound] whose venom is baleful: / O Arundhatī, […]

15.17.s: yat pṛthivyāṃ viṣaṃ vīrutsv adhi yad viṣam | … ||
15.17.d: यत् पृथिव्यां विषं वीरुत्स्व् अधि यद् विषम् । … ॥
15.17.m: What poison is on the earth, / what poison is upon the creeping shrubs, / […]

15.17.s: yad oṣadhībhyaḥ saṃbharanti brahmāṇo menaye viṣam | … ||
15.17.d: यद् ओषधीभ्यः संभरन्ति ब्रह्माणो मेनये विषम् । … ॥
15.17.m: The poison which the priests gather from the plants / for an injury, / […]
The poison which the Brahmins gather, / the sharp serpent-venom, / […]

15.17.s: yaḥ kṣipto mṛtyunā yasmair yo daṣṭas tṛṣṭadaṃśmabhiḥ | arundhati tvaṃ tasyāsi viṣasya viṣadūṣaṇī ||
15.17.d: यः क्षिप्तो मृत्युना यस्मैर् यो दष्टस् तृष्टदंश्मभिः । अरुन्धति त्वं तस्यासि विषस्य विषदूषणी ॥
15.17.m: He who is struck down by death with these, / he who is bitten by sharp-fanged creatures: / O Arundhatī, of that poison / you are the poison-spoiler.

15.17.s: saṃ jihīṣvāmukthā yakṣmād ārukṣo lokam uttamam | apā jīvasi pātreṇa adhi jīvapurā ihi ||
15.17.d: सं जिहीष्वामुक्था यक्ष्माद् आरुक्षो लोकम् उत्तमम् । अपा जीवसि पात्रेण अधि जीवपुरा इहि ॥
15.17.m: Rise up! You have been freed from consumption; / you have climbed up to the highest world. / You live by the vessel of waters; / go upon the strongholds of the living!

15.18.s: apsaraso vi vo yakṛd vi vo bhinadmi mehanam | vi caṇḍālaṃ vy arjunaṃ vi vavṛtraṃ bhinadmi vaḥ ||
15.18.d: अप्सरसो वि वो यकृद् वि वो भिनद्मि मेहनम् । वि चण्डालं व्य् अर्जुनं वि ववृत्रं भिनद्मि वः ॥
15.18.m: O Apsarases, I cleave apart your liver, / I cleave apart your urethra; / I cleave apart your caṇḍāla, your arjuna, / your vavṛtra!

15.18.s: viśvajanyāḥ pāñcajanyā mahārukmāḥ śikhaṇḍinīḥ | sarvā indrasya vajreṇa hatā budbudayātavaḥ ||
15.18.d: विश्वजन्याः पाञ्चजन्या महारुक्माः शिखण्डिनीः । सर्वा इन्द्रस्य वज्रेण हता बुद्बुदयातवः ॥
15.18.m: Belonging to all peoples, belonging to the five peoples, / having large gold ornaments, crested— / all have been slain by Indra's thunderbolt, / the bubble-sorceries!

15.18.s: andhācīm asitācīm ulūkhalasya budhnena | avaitaṃ vatsapaṃ jahi ||
15.18.d: अन्धाचीम् असिताचीम् उलूखलस्य बुध्नेन । अवैतं वत्सपं जहि ॥
15.18.m: With the bottom of the mortar, / slay the dark one, the black one, / strike down that calf-drinker!

15.18.s: dūrād enāḥ praty ā paśyam āpatantīr atho divaḥ | devānāṃ havyamohanīr indro apsaraso hanat ||
15.18.d: दूराद् एनाः प्रत्य् आ पश्यम् आपतन्तीर् अथो दिवः । देवानां हव्यमोहनीर् इन्द्रो अप्सरसो हनत् ॥
15.18.m: From afar I looked upon them / flying down, and from heaven; / bewildering the oblation of the gods, / let Indra slay the Apsarases!

15.18.s: ā hatā apa tā itaḥ khalād iva yātudhānyaḥ | amuṃ gacchata pūruṣaṃ samudram apa gacchati ||
15.18.d: आ हता अप ता इतः खलाद् इव यातुधान्यः । अमुं गच्छत पूरुषं समुद्रम् अप गच्छति ॥
15.18.m: Beaten, go away from here, / like sorceresses from the threshing-floor! / Go to yonder man / who goes away to the ocean!

15.18.s: divaṃ gacchantu divyāḥ saro gacchantu sārasīḥ | uluṅgulasya yo guhas tad u gacchantv āsurīḥ ||
15.18.d: दिवं गच्छन्तु दिव्याः सरो गच्छन्तु सारसीः । उलुङ्गुलस्य यो गुहस् तद् उ गच्छन्त्व् आसुरीः ॥
15.18.m: Let the heavenly ones go to heaven, / let the water-dwelling ones go to the lake; / what is the secret [realm] of the Uluṅgula, / even thither let the demonic ones go!

15.18.s: āskandike viskandike parācīr apa nṛtyantu | sāraṅgeṇa śunā saha ||
15.18.d: आस्कन्दिके विस्कन्दिके पराचीर् अप नृत्यन्तु । सारङ्गेण शुना सह ॥
15.18.m: O leaping one, O scattering one, / turn back and away, / together with the dappled dog!

15.18.s: yaḥ sāraṅgo hiraṇyadan śvā divyaḥ pariplavaḥ | tasyāhaṃ nāma jagrabha asmā ariṣṭatātaye ||
15.18.d: यः सारङ्गो हिरण्यदन् श्वा दिव्यः परिप्लवः । तस्याहं नाम जग्रभ अस्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
15.18.m: The dappled dog / that is heavenly, hovering— / his name have I grasped / for this man's unharmed state.

15.18.s: adyāṃ te viraṇī parācīr apa nṛtyata | śṛṇāmi ghorā vaḥ pṛṣṭī brahmaṇā kīkasā uta ||
15.18.d: अद्यां ते विरणी पराचीर् अप नृत्यत । शृणामि घोरा वः पृष्टी ब्रह्मणा कीकसा उत ॥
15.18.m: Today, turning back, / dance away from him, O tearing ones! / I break your terrible ribs / and your spine with a sacred formula.

15.18.s: ekatriṃśad aśvavatīś catasra uta guṅguvaḥ | śivā daśa śṛtā daśa keśinīḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ | idam uluṅgulukābhyo apsarābhyo 'karaṃ namaḥ ||
15.18.d: एकत्रिंशद् अश्ववतीश् चतस्र उत गुङ्गुवः । शिवा दश शृता दश केशिनीः पञ्चविंशतिः । इदम् उलुङ्गुलुकाभ्यो अप्सराभ्यो ऽकरं नमः ॥
15.18.m: Thirty-one horse-owning ones, / and four Guṅgus; / ten auspicious, ten boiled, / twenty-five long-haired ones: / to these Uluṅgulukā Apsarases / have I paid homage.

15.19.s: yāḥ preṅkhe preṅkhayante santāne mālavā iva | … ||
15.19.d: याः प्रेङ्खे प्रेङ्खयन्ते सन्ताने मालवा इव । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who swing on a swing / like Mālavas in a line, / […]

15.19.s: yāḥ purastād ācaranti sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ | … ||
15.19.d: याः पुरस्ताद् आचरन्ति साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who move in the east / together with the rays of the sun, / […]

15.19.s: yā adharād ācaranty anasā chadisā saha | … ||
15.19.d: या अधराद् आचरन्त्य् अनसा छदिसा सह । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who move from below / together with the cart and its cover, / […]

15.19.s: yāḥ paścād ācaranty andhena tamasā saha | … ||
15.19.d: याः पश्चाद् आचरन्त्य् अन्धेन तमसा सह । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who move from the west / together with blind darkness, / […]

15.19.s: yā uttarād ācaranti varṣeṇa vidyutā saha | … ||
15.19.d: या उत्तराद् आचरन्ति वर्षेण विद्युता सह । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who move from the north / together with rain and lightning, / […]

15.19.s: yā adhastād udvīkṣante sācy akṣi karikratīḥ … ||
15.19.d: या अधस्ताद् उद्वीक्षन्ते साच्य् अक्षि करिक्रतीः … ॥
15.19.m: Those who look upward from below, / making side-long glances, / […]

15.19.s: yā upariṣṭād avekṣante nīle vyaktāni bibhratīḥ | … ||
15.19.d: या उपरिष्टाद् अवेक्षन्ते नीले व्यक्तानि बिभ्रतीः । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who look downward from above, / wearing clear-marked [garments] on dark [bodies], / […]

15.19.s: yā antarikṣa īrayanti vātena reṣmaṇā saha | … ||
15.19.d: या अन्तरिक्ष ईरयन्ति वातेन रेष्मणा सह । … ॥
15.19.m: Those who stir in the intermediate space / together with wind and storm, / […]

15.20.s: tvaj jātā rudra śantamā tvaṃ hi no babhuryā irāya bheṣajebhiḥ | vi yakṣmān yāvayāsmad vy aṃho vy amīvāś cātayāsmad viṣūcīḥ ||
15.20.d: त्वज् जाता रुद्र शन्तमा त्वं हि नो बभुर्या इराय भेषजेभिः । वि यक्ष्मान् यावयास्मद् व्य् अंहो व्य् अमीवाश् चातयास्मद् विषूचीः ॥
15.20.m: Born from you, O Rudra, most beneficent, for you / would bear food for us with healing remedies: / keep consumption far from us, keep narrow distress away, / and chase away diseases in all directions from us!

15.20.s: tvaṃ devānām asi rudra śreṣṭhas tavas tavasām ugrabāho | hṛṇīyasā manasā modamāna ā babhūvitha rudrasya sūnoḥ ||
15.20.d: त्वं देवानाम् असि रुद्र श्रेष्ठस् तवस् तवसाम् उग्रबाहो । हृणीयसा मनसा मोदमान आ बभूविथ रुद्रस्य सूनोः ॥
15.20.m: You are the best of the gods, O Rudra, / strongest of the strong, O fierce-armed one! / Gladdening with an angry mind, / you have come into being for the son of Rudra.

15.20.s: tvaṃ hi no vīrām̐ īraya bheṣajebhir uruṃ no bhavanta maghavo marutvan | karā naḥ pāram aṃhasaḥ svasti viśvā abhītīr apa sedhāsmat ||
15.20.d: त्वं हि नो वीराँ ईरय भेषजेभिर् उरुं नो भवन्त मघवो मरुत्वन् । करा नः पारम् अंहसः स्वस्ति विश्वा अभीतीर् अप सेधास्मत् ॥
15.20.m: For do you stir our heroes with medicines; / become wide for us, O bounteous one accompanied by the Maruts! / Bring us safely beyond distress; / ward off all assaults from us!

15.20.s: tvaṃ hi no vṛṣabha cakṣimeṣṭhā asmai rudrāyogrāya mīḍhuṣe | kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matiṃ yathā naḥ śam aso dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
15.20.d: त्वं हि नो वृषभ चक्षिमेष्ठा अस्मै रुद्रायोग्राय मीढुषे । क्षयद्वीराय प्र भरामहे मतिं यथा नः शम् असो द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
15.20.m: For you, O bull, are seated before our eyes; / to this fierce, generous Rudra, / ruler of heroes, we bring forth a prayer, / that there may be peace for our two-footed, peace for our four-footed.

15.20.s: kva teṣu rudra hasto mṛḍayāko jalāṣaḥ | apabhartā rapaso daivyasya ||
15.20.d: क्व तेषु रुद्र हस्तो मृडयाको जलाषः । अपभर्ता रपसो दैव्यस्य ॥
15.20.m: Where among these, O Rudra, is your hand / that is merciful, healing, / the remover of divine affliction?

15.20.s: pra yakṣmaḥ pra nirṛtir etv asmat seneva sṛṣṭā pracatām amīvā | ārādhvaṃ sanā vṛjanā jahīta ||
15.20.d: प्र यक्ष्मः प्र निरृतिर् एत्व् अस्मत् सेनेव सृष्टा प्रचताम् अमीवा । आराध्वं सना वृजना जहीत ॥
15.20.m: Let consumption go forth, let Nirṛti go forth from us; / let diseases wander away like an army sent forth! / Make straight the ancient enclosures!

15.20.s: arhan dhanur hitaṃ bibharṣy arhan niṣkaṃ rajantaṃ viśvarūpam | arhann idaṃ dayase viśvam ejan na te dūraṃ na pariṣṭhāsti te bhava sadyaḥ sarvān pari paśyasi bhūmim ||
15.20.d: अर्हन् धनुर् हितं बिभर्ष्य् अर्हन् निष्कं रजन्तं विश्वरूपम् । अर्हन्न् इदं दयसे विश्वम् एजन् न ते दूरं न परिष्ठास्ति ते भव सद्यः सर्वान् परि पश्यसि भूमिम् ॥
15.20.m: Worthy, you bear the ready bow, / the silver necklace of every form; / worthy, you allot this whole moving world. / Nothing is far for you, there is no obstacle for you, O Bhava; / in an instant you look completely around all the earth.

15.20.s: namas te astu vidyute namas te stanayitnave | namas te astv aśmane yena pradiśam asyasi ||
15.20.d: नमस् ते अस्तु विद्युते नमस् ते स्तनयित्नवे । नमस् ते अस्त्व् अश्मने येन प्रदिशम् अस्यसि ॥
15.20.m: Homage be to your lightning! / Homage to your thunder! / Homage be to your sling-stone / with which you shoot into the quarter!

15.20.s: mā devānām ugra rājann asmākaṃ puruṣā riṣan | rakṣāṃsy asmad yakṣmāṃś ca nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā ||
15.20.d: मा देवानाम् उग्र राजन्न् अस्माकं पुरुषा रिषन् । रक्षांस्य् अस्मद् यक्ष्मांश् च नाशयामसि ब्रह्मणा ॥
15.20.m: O fierce king, let not our men / among the gods suffer harm! / Demonic spirits and consumptions from us / do we destroy by the sacred formula.

15.20.s: brahmaṇeto nāśayāmo yat kiṃ cāṅgeṣv āmayat | śalyān yakṣmasyātho ropīs tā ito vi nayāmasi ||
15.20.d: ब्रह्मणेतो नाशयामो यत् किं चाङ्गेष्व् आमयत् । शल्यान् यक्ष्मस्याथो रोपीस् ता इतो वि नयामसि ॥
15.20.m: By the sacred formula we destroy from here / whatever ailed in the limbs; / the splinters of consumption, and also sharp pains— / these do we lead away from here.

15.21.s: nayāmi vāṃ paśupatī ghṛtenājyena vardhayan | yaṃ dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tasya veśaḥ kariṣyathaḥ ||
15.21.d: नयामि वां पशुपती घृतेनाज्येन वर्धयन् । यं द्विष्मो यश् च नो द्वेष्टि तस्य वेशः करिष्यथः ॥
15.21.m: I lead you two, O Lords of Cattle, / strengthening you with ghee and sacrificial butter; / he whom we hate and he who hates us— / of him you two shall make an abode.

15.21.s: adhi brūtaṃ paśupatī dvipade me catuṣpade | prasūtau yatra jaghnatus tato me mātaraṃ riṣat ||
15.21.d: अधि ब्रूतं पशुपती द्विपदे मे चतुष्पदे । प्रसूतौ यत्र जघ्नतुस् ततो मे मातरं रिषत् ॥
15.21.m: Intercede, O Lords of Cattle, / for my two-footed and four-footed [creatures]! / When in childbirth you two struck, / thence let harm [be averted from] my mother!

15.21.s: yā vāṃ rudraḥ śivā tanū yā vāṃ santi rogaṇāḥ | yā vām āyuṣmatīs tanūs tābhir no mṛḍataṃ yuvam ||
15.21.d: या वां रुद्रः शिवा तनू या वां सन्ति रोगणाः । या वाम् आयुष्मतीस् तनूस् ताभिर् नो मृडतं युवम् ॥
15.21.m: What forms of yours, O Rudra, are auspicious, / what forms of yours bring disease, / what forms of yours are long-lived— / with those do you two show us mercy!

15.21.s: na pra minanti vratino vratāni satyaṃ jinvanto vidathā vadantaḥ | yasyeme rodasī ubhe saṃyukte manasā hṛdā ||
15.21.d: न प्र मिनन्ति व्रतिनो व्रतानि सत्यं जिन्वन्तो विदथा वदन्तः । यस्येमे रोदसी उभे संयुक्ते मनसा हृदा ॥
15.21.m: The observant do not violate their vows, / enlivening truth, speaking at gatherings, / of whom both these world-halves / are joined by mind and heart.

15.21.s: sa prajānāṃ prajāpatiḥ sādhu rakṣati varṣati | sa veda ratnabheṣajaṃ devebhyas pary ābhṛtaṃ tena no mṛḍataṃ yuvam | jīvātave na martave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye ||
15.21.d: स प्रजानां प्रजापतिः साधु रक्षति वर्षति । स वेद रत्नभेषजं देवेभ्यस् पर्य् आभृतं तेन नो मृडतं युवम् । जीवातवे न मर्तवे ऽथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
15.21.m: He, the Prajāpati of creatures, / guards well and sends rain; / he knows the jewel-remedy / brought from the gods: / therewith do you two show us mercy, / that we may live, not die, / and for unharmed state.

15.21.s: saguṇāsa āsate saṃyuktā balāya kam | teṣāṃ yad indriyaṃ vṛha cati rocati rocanā ||
15.21.d: सगुणास आसते संयुक्ता बलाय कम् । तेषां यद् इन्द्रियं वृह चति रोचति रोचना ॥
15.21.m: Endowed with virtues they sit, / united together for strength; / what great power of theirs [is there], / it shines and brightens the firmaments.

15.21.s: ye te rocane bṛhatī antarikṣe atho divaḥ | tābhyām upa pra yāhi naḥ sarvavīrām̐ ariṣyataḥ ||
15.21.d: ये ते रोचने बृहती अन्तरिक्षे अथो दिवः । ताभ्याम् उप प्र याहि नः सर्ववीराँ अरिष्यतः ॥
15.21.m: Those two lofty bright realms of yours / in the intermediate space and from heaven— / with them come forth to us / whose heroes are whole, who shall not suffer harm!

15.21.s: sarvavīrā ariṣyanto rocane adhi tasthima | yathā nas tṛṣṇamad vasu divi kṣipadbhyo apsu yā ||
15.21.d: सर्ववीरा अरिष्यन्तो रोचने अधि तस्थिम । यथा नस् तृष्णमद् वसु दिवि क्षिपद्भ्यो अप्सु या ॥
15.21.m: With all our heroes whole, not suffering harm, / we have stood upon the bright realm, / that our thirsty wealth may be [safe], / which belongs to those who dart down in heaven, in the waters.

15.22.s: indrāgnī huve prathamau hvayāmi marutaḥ śivān | hvayāmi viśvān devān imaṃ homam avantu me ||
15.22.d: इन्द्राग्नी हुवे प्रथमौ ह्वयामि मरुतः शिवान् । ह्वयामि विश्वान् देवान् इमं होमम् अवन्तु मे ॥
15.22.m: Indra and Agni I call first; / I call the auspicious Maruts; / I call the All-Gods: / let them favor this oblation of mine!

15.22.s: tvaṃ prathamo amṛtatvam agne devo devatvaṃ prathamo jigetha | tava divi hṛdayaṃ saṃ babhūva sa naḥ śivā āpo jātavedo ni yaccha ||
15.22.d: त्वं प्रथमो अमृतत्वम् अग्ने देवो देवत्वं प्रथमो जिगेथ । तव दिवि हृदयं सं बभूव स नः शिवा आपो जातवेदो नि यच्छ ॥
15.22.m: You first, O Agni, [attained] immortality; / as god you first won godhood; / your heart was united in heaven: / do you, O Jātavedas, grant us auspicious waters!

15.22.s: agnāv agniś carati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇāṃ putro adhirāja eṣaḥ | tasmai juhomi haviṣā ghṛtena mā devānāṃ yūyavad bhāgadheyam ||
15.22.d: अग्नाव् अग्निश् चरति प्रविष्ट ऋषीणां पुत्रो अधिराज एषः । तस्मै जुहोमि हविषा घृतेन मा देवानां यूयवद् भागधेयम् ॥
15.22.m: Agni has entered Agni and moves; / son of the ṛṣis, he is the sovereign. / To him do I sacrifice with oblation and ghee; / let him not separate the share of the gods!

15.22.s: ye devā divi ṣṭha ye pṛthivyāṃ jātavedo ya urāv antarikṣe | ye giriṣu parvateṣv apsv antas te devā aśaniṃ yāvayātha ||
15.22.d: ये देवा दिवि ष्ठ ये पृथिव्यां जातवेदो य उराव् अन्तरिक्षे । ये गिरिषु पर्वतेष्व् अप्स्व् अन्तस् ते देवा अशनिं यावयाथ ॥
15.22.m: The gods who are in heaven, who are on earth, / O Jātavedas, and who are in the wide intermediate space, / who are on the mountains, on hills, and within the waters— / do you gods keep the thunderbolt far away!

15.22.s: mitraṃ digbhiḥ kṛṇuṣva jātaveda āśābhir mitram adhipā vipaścit | mā no hiṃsīr divyenāgninā sasyāṃ yena yanti maruta spardhamānāḥ ||
15.22.d: मित्रं दिग्भिः कृणुष्व जातवेद आशाभिर् मित्रम् अधिपा विपश्चित् । मा नो हिंसीर् दिव्येनाग्निना सस्यां येन यन्ति मरुत स्पर्धमानाः ॥
15.22.m: Make a friend with the quarters, O Jātavedas, / a friend with the regions, O wise overlord! / Do not harm our standing crop with divine fire, / by which the Maruts race in rivalry!

15.22.s: vidyotamāna stanayan vṛṣevaiṣi kanikradat | bhīmaḥ parjanya te rathaḥ sa u naḥ śarma yacchatu ||
15.22.d: विद्योतमान स्तनयन् वृषेवैषि कनिक्रदत् । भीमः पर्जन्य ते रथः स उ नः शर्म यच्छतु ॥
15.22.m: Flashing, thundering, / like a bull you come bellowing. / Terrible is your chariot, O Parjanya; / let it grant us protection!

15.22.s: ye vidyutam aśanim ā tanvanti marutaḥ salilād adhi | kṛṣyai no viśvavārāyā avadhanvā ni tanvatām ||
15.22.d: ये विद्युतम् अशनिम् आ तन्वन्ति मरुतः सलिलाद् अधि । कृष्यै नो विश्ववाराया अवधन्वा नि तन्वताम् ॥
15.22.m: The Maruts who stretch out lightning and thunderbolt / from the flood of water— / for our field of all desirable things / let them slacken their unbent bows!

15.22.s: yo vidyutam aśanim ātaṃty antarikṣād uta vātād divaś ca | tebhyo marudbhyo namo 'stv ojase ||
15.22.d: यो विद्युतम् अशनिम् आतंत्य् अन्तरिक्षाद् उत वाताद् दिवश् च । तेभ्यो मरुद्भ्यो नमो ऽस्त्व् ओजसे ॥
15.22.m: He who stretches lightning and thunderbolt / from the intermediate space, and from the wind, and from heaven— / to those Maruts, to their might, let homage be!

15.22.s: tā yantu svaraṃkṛtāḥ syonāḥ śivatamāḥ pathā | mā na indra yavaṃ vadhīr mitramenena kṛṇmahe ||
15.22.d: ता यन्तु स्वरंकृताः स्योनाः शिवतमाः पथा । मा न इन्द्र यवं वधीर् मित्रमेनेन कृण्महे ॥
15.22.m: Let them go well-adorned, / pleasant, most auspicious along their path! / Do not strike our barley, O Indra; / we make a friend with this [hymn].

15.22.s: darbho agra oṣadhīnāṃ śatakāṇḍo ajāyata | sa devaiḥ prahito 'yam āgan svastaye vṛṣā marudbhiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ ||
15.22.d: दर्भो अग्र ओषधीनां शतकाण्डो अजायत । स देवैः प्रहितो ऽयम् आगन् स्वस्तये वृषा मरुद्भिः सह संविदानः ॥
15.22.m: Darbha-grass was born foremost of herbs, / having a hundred joints. / Sent forth by the gods, this bull has come / for well-being, in concord with the Maruts.

15.23.s: vṛṣākṣasyāsurasya menir asi tāṃ tvayā tathā veda karṇasya kauvidasyevamāśā | tāṃ mābhy ava gā dvādaśāhnāni vi rakṣe ||
15.23.d: वृषाक्षस्यासुरस्य मेनिर् असि तां त्वया तथा वेद कर्णस्य कौविदस्येवमाशा । तां माभ्य् अव गा द्वादशाह्नानि वि रक्षे ॥
15.23.m: You are the wrath of the bull-eyed asura; / through you I know of Karṇa / as the hope of Kauvida; / do not come down upon it for twelve days; I ward you off!

15.23.s: asir me tigmasyāyasa indrāgnibhyāṃ susaṃśitaḥ | tena sedhām id āduniṃ kṛṣiṃ me māva gād iti sasyaṃ me mā vadhīd iti ||
15.23.d: असिर् मे तिग्मस्यायस इन्द्राग्निभ्यां सुसंशितः । तेन सेधाम् इद् आदुनिं कृषिं मे माव गाद् इति सस्यं मे मा वधीद् इति ॥
15.23.m: My knife is of sharp iron, / well whetted by Indra and Agni; / with it I drive away the hailstone: / 'Let it not fall upon my field! / Let it not destroy my standing crop!'

15.23.s: marutaḥ pari vṛṅdhi no divaḥ kṣudrebhir aśmabhiḥ | udumbarasya śākhayā vicakṣuṣā aśaniṃ yāvayāmasi ||
15.23.d: मरुतः परि वृङ्धि नो दिवः क्षुद्रेभिर् अश्मभिः । उदुम्बरस्य शाखया विचक्षुषा अशनिं यावयामसि ॥
15.23.m: O Maruts, spare us / from heaven with your small stones! / With the far-seeing branch of the udumbara / we keep the thunderbolt away.

15.23.s: maruto mṛḍayāta no divaḥ śukrebhir aśmabhiḥ | udumbarasya śākhayā vicakṣuṣā aśaṇiṃ yāvayāmasi ||
15.23.d: मरुतो मृडयात नो दिवः शुक्रेभिर् अश्मभिः । उदुम्बरस्य शाखया विचक्षुषा अशणिं यावयामसि ॥
15.23.m: O Maruts, have mercy on us / from heaven with your bright stones! / With the far-seeing branch of the udumbara / we keep the thunderbolt away.

15.23.s: vartād vartam ā krāma parvatād adhi parvatam | girau pratiśṛtā satī vṛkṣān bhaṅdhi mā yavam ||
15.23.d: वर्ताद् वर्तम् आ क्राम पर्वताद् अधि पर्वतम् । गिरौ प्रतिशृता सती वृक्षान् भङ्धि मा यवम् ॥
15.23.m: Leap from roll to roll, / from mountain onto mountain! / Resting upon the mountain, / break the trees, not the barley!

15.23.s: adāmnā tvā sandhyāmi yāvaṇyā paribhūrṇyā | sānau pratiśṛtā satī tṛṇaṃ bhaṅdhi mā yavam ||
15.23.d: अदाम्ना त्वा सन्ध्यामि यावण्या परिभूर्ण्या । सानौ प्रतिशृता सती तृणं भङ्धि मा यवम् ॥
15.23.m: With an unloosened bond I bind you, / with an all-encompassing, repelling [cord]. / Resting upon the mountain-ridge, / break the grass, not the barley!

15.23.s: uśatī nāmāsi salindā nāma | anyām āsāṃ gaccha yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ gaccha ||
15.23.d: उशती नामासि सलिन्दा नाम । अन्याम् आसां गच्छ यं द्विष्मस् तं गच्छ ॥
15.23.m: Longing is your name, Salindā is your name. / Go to another of these; go to him whom we hate!

15.23.s: parācīm anu saṃvataṃ parācīm anu saṃvidaṃ parācy anu ni drava | itas tvā nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryāvatā ||
15.23.d: पराचीम् अनु संवतं पराचीम् अनु संविदं पराच्य् अनु नि द्रव । इतस् त्वा नाशयामसि ब्रह्मणा वीर्यावता ॥
15.23.m: Along the turned-away slope, / along the turned-away knowledge, / run down turned away! / From here we destroy you / with mighty sacred prayer.

15.23.s: vār bhavodakaṃ bhava udakasyodakaṃ bhava | kṣudrāt kṣodīyasī bhūtvā athehy adhamaṃ tamaḥ ||
15.23.d: वार् भवोदकं भव उदकस्योदकं भव । क्षुद्रात् क्षोदीयसी भूत्वा अथेह्य् अधमं तमः ॥
15.23.m: Become water, become liquid, / become the water of water! / Having become finer than the small, / go then into the lowest darkness!

15.23.s: syonā bhava śivā bhava śivāc chivatarā bhava | phenān mṛdīyasī bhūtvā idaṃ śasyam upā cara ||
15.23.d: स्योना भव शिवा भव शिवाच् छिवतरा भव । फेनान् मृदीयसी भूत्वा इदं शस्यम् उपा चर ॥
15.23.m: Become kindly, become auspicious, / become more auspicious than the auspicious! / Having become softer than foam, / approach this crop!

15.23.s: namas te astu vidyute stanayitnave | namas te agne dūre hete kṛṇmo mā no hiṃsīr dvipado mā catuṣpadaḥ ||
15.23.d: नमस् ते अस्तु विद्युते स्तनयित्नवे । नमस् ते अग्ने दूरे हेते कृण्मो मा नो हिंसीर् द्विपदो मा चतुष्पदः ॥
15.23.m: Homage be to your lightning, to your thunder! / Homage to you, O Agni of far-reaching missile, we render: / do not harm our two-footed, do not harm our four-footed!

15.23.s: prati tvā sahasāsahaḥ sahasā prati rudhmasi | aindram idaṃ saho mahad bhūmyās tavaṃ divi śritam | aphālakṛṣṭam ā krama mā na indra yavaṃ vadhīḥ ||
15.23.d: प्रति त्वा सहसासहः सहसा प्रति रुध्मसि । ऐन्द्रम् इदं सहो महद् भूम्यास् तवं दिवि श्रितम् । अफालकृष्टम् आ क्रम मा न इन्द्र यवं वधीः ॥
15.23.m: With force we check you, / who overpower with force! / This great force belonging to Indra, / a layer of the earth, rests in heaven. / Go onto unplowed land! / O Indra, do not strike down our barley!

15.23.s: yāḥ samudrād uccaranty utsebhyo yā nadībhyaḥ | atyantaḥ sarpo vaidyuto 'śaniṃ yāvayād itaḥ ||
15.23.d: याः समुद्राद् उच्चरन्त्य् उत्सेभ्यो या नदीभ्यः । अत्यन्तः सर्पो वैद्युतो ऽशनिं यावयाद् इतः ॥
15.23.m: Those [waters] which rise up from the sea, / which from fountains, from rivers, / [may] the inner-creeping lightning serpent / drive away the thunderbolt from here! || anuvāka 5

16.1.s: antakāya mṛtyave nama iha ayam astu puruṣaḥ sahāsunā | sūryasya bhāge amṛtasya loke prāṇā apānā iha te ramantām ||
16.1.d: अन्तकाय मृत्यवे नम इह अयम् अस्तु पुरुषः सहासुना । सूर्यस्य भागे अमृतस्य लोके प्राणा अपाना इह ते रमन्ताम् ॥
16.1.m: Homage to End-making Death! May this / man be here together with life! / In the realm of the sun, in the world of the immortal, / may your out-breaths and in-breaths rejoice here!

16.1.s: ud enaṃ bhago agrabhīd ud enaṃ somo aṃśumān | ud enaṃ maruto devā ud indrāgnī svastaye ||
16.1.d: उद् एनं भगो अग्रभीद् उद् एनं सोमो अंशुमान् । उद् एनं मरुतो देवा उद् इन्द्राग्नी स्वस्तये ॥
16.1.m: Bhaga has taken him upward, / Soma rich in shoots [has taken] him upward, / the divine Maruts upward, / Indra and Agni upward for well-being.

16.1.s: iha te 'sur iha prāṇa ihāyur iha te manaḥ | ut tvā nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo daivyā vācā bharāmasi ||
16.1.d: इह ते ऽसुर् इह प्राण इहायुर् इह ते मनः । उत् त्वा निरृत्याः पाशेभ्यो दैव्या वाचा भरामसि ॥
16.1.m: Here is your life, here your breath, / here your lifespan, here your mind! / Up from the fetters of Nirṛti / we lift [you] with divine speech.

16.1.s: ut krāmāto māva patthā mṛtyoḥ paḍvīśam avamuñcamānaḥ | mā cchitthā asmāl lokād agneḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśaḥ ||
16.1.d: उत् क्रामातो माव पत्था मृत्योः पड्वीशम् अवमुञ्चमानः । मा च्छित्था अस्माल् लोकाद् अग्नेः सूर्यस्य संदृशः ॥
16.1.m: Step upward from here, do not fall down, / unloosening the foot-shackle of Death! / Do not be cut off from this world, / from the sight of Agni and Sūrya!

16.1.s: tubhyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ mātariśvā tubhyaṃ varṣantv amṛtāny āpaḥ | sūryas te tanve śaṃ tapāt tvāṃ mṛtyur dayatāṃ mā pra meṣṭhāḥ ||
16.1.d: तुभ्यं वातः पवतां मातरिश्वा तुभ्यं वर्षन्त्व् अमृतान्य् आपः । सूर्यस् ते तन्वे शं तपात् त्वां मृत्युर् दयतां मा प्र मेष्ठाः ॥
16.1.m: For you let the wind Mātariśvan blow, / for you let the immortal waters rain! / May the sun be auspicious to your body; / may Death have mercy on you, do not perish!

16.1.s: udyānaṃ te puruṣa nāvayānaṃ jīvātaṃ te dakṣatātiṃ kṛṇotu | ā hi rohemam amṛtaṃ sukhaṃ ratham atha jirvir vidatham ā vadāsi ||
16.1.d: उद्यानं ते पुरुष नावयानं जीवातं ते दक्षतातिं कृणोतु । आ हि रोहेमम् अमृतं सुखं रथम् अथ जिर्विर् विदथम् आ वदासि ॥
16.1.m: An ascent be yours, O man, not a descent! / May a living person make ability for you! / Mount indeed this immortal, comfortable chariot; / then, grown old, you shall speak to the council!

16.1.s: mā te manas tatra gān mā tiro bhūn mā jīvebhyaḥ pra mado mānu gāḥ pitṝn | viśve devā abhi rakṣantu tveha ||
16.1.d: मा ते मनस् तत्र गान् मा तिरो भून् मा जीवेभ्यः प्र मदो मानु गाः पितॄन् । विश्वे देवा अभि रक्षन्तु त्वेह ॥
16.1.m: Let your mind not go there, let it not vanish; / do not become reckless away from the living, do not follow the fathers! / May All the Gods protect you here!

16.1.s: mā gatānām ā dīdhīthā ye nayanti parāvatam | ud ā roha tamaso jyotir ehy ā te hastaṃ rabhāmahe
16.1.d: मा गतानाम् आ दीधीथा ये नयन्ति परावतम् । उद् आ रोह तमसो ज्योतिर् एह्य् आ ते हस्तं रभामहे
16.1.m: Do not yearn after the departed / who lead to the far distance! / Climb up from the darkness, come to the light! / We take hold of your hand.

16.1.s: śyāmaś ca tvā śabalaś ca preṣitau yamasya yau pathirakṣī śvānau | arvāṅ ehi mā vi dīdhyo māti tiṣṭhaḥ parāṅmanāḥ ||
16.1.d: श्यामश् च त्वा शबलश् च प्रेषितौ यमस्य यौ पथिरक्षी श्वानौ । अर्वाङ् एहि मा वि दीध्यो माति तिष्ठः पराङ्मनाः ॥
16.1.m: The dark and the brindled [hound] are sent forth, / the two dogs of Yama who guard the path. / Come hither, do not look away! / Do not stay turned away in mind!

16.1.s: maitaṃ panthām anu gā bhīma eṣa yena pūrvaṃ nayatha taṃ bravīmi | tama etat puruṣa mā pra patthā bhayaṃ parastād abhayaṃ te arvāk ||
16.1.d: मैतं पन्थाम् अनु गा भीम एष येन पूर्वं नयथ तं ब्रवीमि । तम एतत् पुरुष मा प्र पत्था भयं परस्ताद् अभयं ते अर्वाक् ॥
16.1.m: Do not follow this path—it is frightful; / that by which they led before, of that I speak. / This is darkness, O man, do not fall into it! / Danger is beyond, safety is hither for you.

16.2.s: rakṣantu tvāgnayo ye apsv antā rakṣatu tvā manuṣyā yam indhate | vaiśvānaro rakṣatu jātavedā divyas tvā mā pra dhāg vidyutā saha ||
16.2.d: रक्षन्तु त्वाग्नयो ये अप्स्व् अन्ता रक्षतु त्वा मनुष्या यम् इन्धते । वैश्वानरो रक्षतु जातवेदा दिव्यस् त्वा मा प्र धाग् विद्युता सह ॥
16.2.m: May the fires that are within the waters protect you; / may the fire that men kindle protect you; / may Vaiśvānara Jātavedas protect you; / may the heavenly [fire] with lightning not burn you!

16.2.s: rakṣatu tvā pṛthivī rakṣatu dyaus sūryaś ca tvā rakṣatāṃ candramāś ca | mā tvā kravyād abhi maṃsta ārāt saṃkasukāc cara ||
16.2.d: रक्षतु त्वा पृथिवी रक्षतु द्यौस् सूर्यश् च त्वा रक्षतां चन्द्रमाश् च । मा त्वा क्रव्याद् अभि मंस्त आरात् संकसुकाच् चर ॥
16.2.m: May the earth protect you, may heaven protect you, / may the sun and the moon protect you! / Let the flesh-eating [fire] not fix upon you; / stay far away from Saṃkasuka!

16.2.s: antarikṣaṃ rakṣatu devahetyā bodhaś ca tvā pratībodhaś ca rakṣatām | asvapnaś ca tvānavadrāṇaś ca rakṣatāṃ gopāyaṃś ca tvā rakṣatāṃ jāgṛviś ca ||
16.2.d: अन्तरिक्षं रक्षतु देवहेत्या बोधश् च त्वा प्रतीबोधश् च रक्षताम् । अस्वप्नश् च त्वानवद्राणश् च रक्षतां गोपायंश् च त्वा रक्षतां जागृविश् च ॥
16.2.m: May the atmosphere protect [you] from the divine weapon; / may Bodha and Pratībodha protect you; / may Asvapna and Anavadrāṇa protect you; / may Gopāyant and Jāgṛvi protect you!

16.2.s: te tvā rakṣantu te tvā gopāyantu te tvāṃhasas pāntu | tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
16.2.d: ते त्वा रक्षन्तु ते त्वा गोपायन्तु ते त्वांहसस् पान्तु । तेभ्यो नमस् तेभ्यः स्वाहा ॥
16.2.m: May they protect you, may they guard you, may they keep you from distress! / Homage to them, svāhā to them!

16.2.s: jīvebhyas tvā samude vāyur indro dhātā dadhātu savitā trāyamāṇaḥ | mā tvā prāṇo balaṃ hāsīd asuṃ te 'nu hvayāmasi ||
16.2.d: जीवेभ्यस् त्वा समुदे वायुर् इन्द्रो धाता दधातु सविता त्रायमाणः । मा त्वा प्राणो बलं हासीद् असुं ते ऽनु ह्वयामसि ॥
16.2.m: For rejoicing among the living may Vāyu, Indra, / Dhātṛ, and Savitṛ place you, protecting. / Let breath and strength not abandon you; / we call your life back!

16.2.s: mā tvā jambhaḥ saṃhanur mā tamo vidan mā jihvā barhiḥ pramayuḥ kathā syāḥ | ut tvādityā vasavo bharantu ud indrāgnī svastaye ||
16.2.d: मा त्वा जम्भः संहनुर् मा तमो विदन् मा जिह्वा बर्हिः प्रमयुः कथा स्याः । उत् त्वादित्या वसवो भरन्तु उद् इन्द्राग्नी स्वस्तये ॥
16.2.m: Let not the crusher, nor the jaw, nor darkness find you; / let your tongue not [become] sacrificial grass; how could you perish? / May the Ādityas and the Vasus lift you up, / Indra and Agni upward for well-being!

16.2.s: ayaṃ devā ihaivāstv ayaṃ māmutra gād itaḥ | imaṃ sahasravīryeṇa mṛtyor ut pārayāmasi ||
16.2.d: अयं देवा इहैवास्त्व् अयं मामुत्र गाद् इतः । इमं सहस्रवीर्येण मृत्योर् उत् पारयामसि ॥
16.2.m: May this man remain right here, O gods; / may he not go from here to yonder world! / Him, with thousandfold power, / we rescue from Death.

16.2.s: ut tvā mṛtyor apīparaṃ saṃ dhamantu vayodhasaḥ | mā tvā vyastakeśyo mā tvāgharudo rudan ||
16.2.d: उत् त्वा मृत्योर् अपीपरं सं धमन्तु वयोधसः । मा त्वा व्यस्तकेश्यो मा त्वाघरुदो रुदन् ॥
16.2.m: I have rescued you from Death; / let the vigor-givers blow together [upon you]! / Let not [women] with disheveled hair, / let not women wailing in misery weep for you!

16.2.s: āhārṣaṃ tvāvidaṃ tvā punar āgāḥ punarṇavaḥ | sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣuḥ sarvam āyuś ca te 'vidam ||
16.2.d: आहार्षं त्वाविदं त्वा पुनर् आगाः पुनर्णवः । सर्वाङ्ग सर्वं ते चक्षुः सर्वम् आयुश् च ते ऽविदम् ॥
16.2.m: I have fetched you, I have found you; / you have come back, renewed! / Complete in limbs, your entire sight / and your whole lifespan I have found.

16.2.s: ut tvā dyaur ut pṛthivy ut prajāpatir agrabhīt | ut tvā mṛtyor oṣadhayaḥ | somarājñīr apīparan ||
16.2.d: उत् त्वा द्यौर् उत् पृथिव्य् उत् प्रजापतिर् अग्रभीत् । उत् त्वा मृत्योर् ओषधयः । सोमराज्ञीर् अपीपरन् ॥
16.2.m: Heaven has seized you upward, earth upward, / Prajāpati upward; / up from Death the plants / whose queen is Soma have rescued you.

16.2.s: yāvat te jyotir abhūd apa tvat tamo akramīt | apa tvan mṛtyuṃ nirṛtim apa yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi ||
16.2.d: यावत् ते ज्योतिर् अभूद् अप त्वत् तमो अक्रमीत् । अप त्वन् मृत्युं निरृतिम् अप यक्ष्मं नि दध्मसि ॥
16.2.m: As much light as has come to you, / so much has darkness stepped away from you. / Away from you Death, Nirṛti, / away we lay consumption.

16.3.s: ā rabhasvemām amṛtasya śnuṣṭim acchidyamānā jaradaṣṭir astu te | asuṃ ta āyuḥ punar ā bharāmi rajas tamo mopa gā mā pra meṣṭhāḥ ||
16.3.d: आ रभस्वेमाम् अमृतस्य श्नुष्टिम् अच्छिद्यमाना जरदष्टिर् अस्तु ते । असुं त आयुः पुनर् आ भरामि रजस् तमो मोप गा मा प्र मेष्ठाः ॥
16.3.m: Grasp this favor of the immortal; / may reaching old age be yours without interruption! / I bring back your spirit, your lifespan; / do not go to mist and darkness, do not perish!

16.3.s: jīvatāṃ jyotir abhy ehi lokam ā tvā harāmi śataśāradāya | drāghīya āyuḥ prataraṃ te kṛṇomy ava muñcantu mṛtyupāśā aśastīḥ ||
16.3.d: जीवतां ज्योतिर् अभ्य् एहि लोकम् आ त्वा हरामि शतशारदाय । द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं ते कृणोम्य् अव मुञ्चन्तु मृत्युपाशा अशस्तीः ॥
16.3.m: Come unto the world of the living, to the light! / I fetch you for a hundred autumns. / I make your lifespan longer, extended; / let the fetters of Death, the curses, loosen!

16.3.s: vātāt te prāṇam avidaṃ sūryāc cakṣur ahaṃ pari | yat te manas tvayi tad dhārayāmi saṃ vitsvāṅgair vada jihvayālapan ||
16.3.d: वातात् ते प्राणम् अविदं सूर्याच् चक्षुर् अहं परि । यत् ते मनस् त्वयि तद् धारयामि सं वित्स्वाङ्गैर् वद जिह्वयालपन् ॥
16.3.m: I have found your breath from the wind, / your sight from the sun. / That mind of yours which was [gone], I maintain in you; / reunite with your limbs, speak babbling with your tongue!

16.3.s: prāṇena tvāṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām agnim iva jātam abhi saṃ dhamāmi | namas te mṛtyo cakṣuṣe namaḥ prāṇāya te 'karam ||
16.3.d: प्राणेन त्वां द्विपदां चतुष्पदाम् अग्निम् इव जातम् अभि सं धमामि । नमस् ते मृत्यो चक्षुषे नमः प्राणाय ते ऽकरम् ॥
16.3.m: With the breath of two-footed and four-footed / I blow upon you like a kindled fire. / Homage to your eye, O Death, / homage have I paid to your breath!

16.3.s: ayaṃ jīvatu mā mṛta imaṃ sam īrayāmasi | kṛṇomy asmai bheṣajaṃ mṛtyo mā puruṣaṃ vadhīḥ ||
16.3.d: अयं जीवतु मा मृत इमं सम् ईरयामसि । कृणोम्य् अस्मै भेषजं मृत्यो मा पुरुषं वधीः ॥
16.3.m: Let this man live, let him not die; / we stir him up! / I prepare a healing medicine for him; / O Death, do not strike down the man!

16.3.s: jīvalāṃ naghāriṣāṃ jīvantīm oṣadhīm aham | trāyamāṇāṃ sahamānāṃ sahasvatīm arundhatīm iha huve 'smā ariṣṭatātaye ||
16.3.d: जीवलां नघारिषां जीवन्तीम् ओषधीम् अहम् । त्रायमाणां सहमानां सहस्वतीम् अरुन्धतीम् इह हुवे ऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
16.3.m: The life-giving, the injury-averting, / the living plant, / the rescuing, prevailing, / powerful Arundhatī / I call here for his unharmed state.

16.3.s: adhi brūhi mā rabhathāḥ sṛjemaṃ tavaiva sant sarvahāyā ihāstu | bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ śarma yacchatam apasidhya duritaṃ dhattam āyuḥ ||
16.3.d: अधि ब्रूहि मा रभथाः सृजेमं तवैव सन्त् सर्वहाया इहास्तु । भवाशर्वौ मृडतं शर्म यच्छतम् अपसिध्य दुरितं धत्तम् आयुः ॥
16.3.m: Intercede! Do not seize [him]! Release him! / Let him be yours with all his years right here! / O Bhava and Śarva, have mercy, grant protection; / warding off misfortune, grant lifespan!

16.3.s: devānāṃ hetiḥ pari tvā vṛṇaktu pārayāmi rajasa ut tvā mṛtyor apīparam | ārād agniṃ kravyādaṃ nirūhan jivātave te paridhiṃ dadhāmi ||
16.3.d: देवानां हेतिः परि त्वा वृणक्तु पारयामि रजस उत् त्वा मृत्योर् अपीपरम् । आराद् अग्निं क्रव्यादं निरूहन् जिवातवे ते परिधिं दधामि ॥
16.3.m: May the missile of the gods bypass you; / I ferry you out of the darkness, I have rescued you from Death. / Removing far away the flesh-eating fire, / I set a perimeter for your living.

16.3.s: asmai mṛtyo adhi brūhi imaṃ dayasvod ito 'yam etu | ariṣṭaḥ sarvāṅgaḥ suśruj jarasā śatahāyanātmanā bhujam aśnavat ||
16.3.d: अस्मै मृत्यो अधि ब्रूहि इमं दयस्वोद् इतो ऽयम् एतु । अरिष्टः सर्वाङ्गः सुश्रुज् जरसा शतहायनात्मना भुजम् अश्नवत् ॥
16.3.m: Intercede for him, O Death! / Have mercy on him, let him rise from here! / Unharmed, complete in limbs, hearing well through old age, / with a body of a hundred years may he enjoy enjoyment!

16.3.s: yat te niyānaṃ rajasaṃ mṛtyo anavadhariṣyam | patha imaṃ tasmād rakṣanto brahmāsmai varma kṛṇmasi ||
16.3.d: यत् ते नियानं रजसं मृत्यो अनवधरिष्यम् । पथ इमं तस्माद् रक्षन्तो ब्रह्मास्मै वर्म कृण्मसि ॥
16.3.m: The misty path of yours, / O Death, which cannot be withstood— / protecting this man from that path, / we make sacred prayer his armor.

16.4.s: kṛṇomi te prāṇāpānau jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ dīrgham āyuḥ svasti | vaivasvatena prahitān yamadūtāṃś carata ārād apa sedhāmi sarvān ||
16.4.d: कृणोमि ते प्राणापानौ जरां मृत्युं कृणुतां दीर्घम् आयुः स्वस्ति । वैवस्वतेन प्रहितान् यमदूतांश् चरत आराद् अप सेधामि सर्वान् ॥
16.4.m: I make your out-breath and in-breath; / may old age and death make long lifespan and well-being! / The messengers of Yama sent by Vaivasvata / that roam about, I ward them all far away.

16.4.s: ārād arātiṃ nirṛtiṃ paro grāhiṃ kravyādaḥ piśacān | rakṣo yat sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ tat tama ivāpa hanmasi ||
16.4.d: आराद् अरातिं निरृतिं परो ग्राहिं क्रव्यादः पिशचान् । रक्षो यत् सर्वं दुर्भूतं तत् तम इवाप हन्मसि ॥
16.4.m: Far away hostility and Nirṛti, / far off Grāhi and flesh-eating Piśācas! / Whatever demon, whatever evil being there is, / that we strike away like darkness.

16.4.s: agneṣ ṭe prāṇam amṛtād āyuṣmato manave jātavedasaḥ | yathā na riṣyā amṛtaḥ sajūr asas tat te kṛṇomi tad u te sam ṛdhyatām ||
16.4.d: अग्नेष् टे प्राणम् अमृताद् आयुष्मतो मनवे जातवेदसः । यथा न रिष्या अमृतः सजूर् असस् तत् ते कृणोमि तद् उ ते सम् ऋध्यताम् ॥
16.4.m: From the immortal, long-lived Jātavedas, for the descendant of Manu, [I take] your breath; / so that you will not come to harm, [but] be immortal, united [with us], / that I do for you; may that thrive for you!

16.4.s: śive te stāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī asantāpe adhiśriyau | śaṃ te sūrya ā tapati śaṃ vāto vātu te hṛde | śivā abhi kṣarantu tvā āpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ śivās te santv oṣadhīḥ ||
16.4.d: शिवे ते स्तां द्यावापृथिवी असन्तापे अधिश्रियौ । शं ते सूर्य आ तपति शं वातो वातु ते हृदे । शिवा अभि क्षरन्तु त्वा आपो दिव्याः पयस्वतीः शिवास् ते सन्त्व् ओषधीः ॥
16.4.m: May heaven and earth be auspicious to you, / free of burning heat, of high fortune! / May the sun shine favorably upon you, / may the wind blow favorably to your heart! / Auspicious may the divine waters, / rich in milk, flow down upon you; / auspicious may the plants be to you!

16.4.s: ut tvāhārṣam adharasyād uttarāṃ pṛthivīm abhi | tatra tvādityau rakṣatāṃ sūryāś candramasā ubhā ||
16.4.d: उत् त्वाहार्षम् अधरस्याद् उत्तरां पृथिवीम् अभि । तत्र त्वादित्यौ रक्षतां सूर्याश् चन्द्रमसा उभा ॥
16.4.m: I have brought you from the lower to the upper earth; / there may both Ādityas protect you, / both the sun and the moon!

16.4.s: yat te vāsaḥ paridhānaṃ yāṃ nīviṃ kṛṇuṣe tvam | śivaṃ te tanve tat kṛṇmaḥ saṃsparśe 'dhrūkṣṇam astu te ||
16.4.d: यत् ते वासः परिधानं यां नीविं कृणुषे त्वम् । शिवं ते तन्वे तत् कृण्मः संस्पर्शे ऽध्रूक्ष्णम् अस्तु ते ॥
16.4.m: Whatever garment is your clothing, / whatever waist-knot you tie, / we make that auspicious to your body; / may it be harmless to your touch!

16.4.s: yat kṣureṇa marcayatā sutejasā vaptā vapasi keśaśmasru | śumbhaṃ mukhaṃ mainam āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
16.4.d: यत् क्षुरेण मर्चयता सुतेजसा वप्ता वपसि केशश्मस्रु । शुम्भं मुखं मैनम् आयुः प्र मोषीः ॥
16.4.m: When as a barber you shave hair and beard / with a cleaning, very sharp razor, / adorning the face, do not rob him of his life!

16.4.s: śivau te stāṃ vrīhiyavāv abalāsāv adomadhau | etau yakṣmaṃ vi bādhete etau muñcato aṃhasaḥ ||
16.4.d: शिवौ ते स्तां व्रीहियवाव् अबलासाव् अदोमधौ । एतौ यक्ष्मं वि बाधेते एतौ मुञ्चतो अंहसः ॥
16.4.m: May rice and barley be auspicious to you, / free from balāsa-disease, free from damage! / These two drive away yakṣma; / these two release from distress.

16.4.s: yad aśnāsi yat pibasi dhānyaṃ kṛṣyāḥ payaḥ | ādyaṃ yad anādyaṃ sarvaṃ te annam aviṣaṃ kṛṇomi ||
